title: AI Video Editor
description:
Velantra makes considered leather goods for women who value quality over noise. Our marketing lives on short-form video, and we're leaning heavily into AI-generated UGC — content that looks and feels like a real person filmed it on their phone, not like an ad. We're bringing on a video editor who can own production end to end and consistently turn out content that's indistinguishable from the real thing.



What You'll Do



You'll own our AI UGC pipeline from concept to finished cut. Day to day, that means:



Producing hyperrealistic AI UGC videos that look and feel natural — the kind of content people don't realize is AI

Working fluently across our core tools: HeyGen (avatars / talking heads), Google Flow (video generation), Seedance 2 (video generation), and ElevenLabs (voice). You'll have full access to all of our tools

Replicating the style of reference videos we give you 1:1 — matching pacing, framing, motion, lighting, and feel so closely that the output is indistinguishable from the reference

Getting the details right that make AI content believable: natural lighting, realistic motion, lip-sync accuracy, believable voice pacing, and clean audio

Editing raw AI-generated clips into polished, native-feeling short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and paid ads

Iterating quickly on feedback and turning around revisions without losing quality

Keeping an organized library of assets, footage, and final exports

What You'll Produce



Your weekly target is 15 finished concepts per week, across a mix of formats:



Short POV-style videos — roughly 10 seconds each

AI UGC greenscreen videos — 35–45 seconds each

Voiceover videos — 35–45 seconds each



For each concept, we'll typically provide a reference video, and your job is to replicate its style 1:1 while adapting it to our product. Consistency, speed, and a believable natural feel matter more than fancy effects.



What We're Looking For

Hands-on experience with HeyGen, Google Flow, Seedance 2, and ElevenLabs. This is a hard requirement — you should already know how to get high-quality output from these tools

A strong eye for what makes AI content look real vs. fake, and the skill to close that gap

The ability to study a reference video and reproduce its style precisely — pacing, framing, motion, and feel

Comfort working at volume and consistently hitting a weekly output target without cutting corners on quality

Solid short-form video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar)

An understanding of the UGC aesthetic — content that feels authentic and unpolished, not like a corporate ad

Fast, reliable, and able to manage your own production schedule without being micromanaged

A stable internet connection and a computer that can handle video work

Nice to Have

Experience creating content for a fashion, beauty, or accessories brand

Familiarity with paid social ad formats and what drives performance

Your own workflow or system for producing AI video efficiently at volume

Hours & Pay



This is a full-time role, 40 hours/week, Monday through Friday. We're flexible on your exact hours as long as there's some daily overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours. Pay starts at $500/month, and we're happy to revisit compensation as you take on more and prove yourself.



How to Apply



Please send a short message that includes:



A quick intro to your AI video experience and the tools you use

A portfolio, reel, or 2–3 example videos you've made using HeyGen, Google Flow, Seedance 2, or ElevenLabs — this is the most important part of your application

Your available working hours (in your local time)

title: AI Video Editor for Fashion Brand
description:
Job Title: AI Video Editor for Fashion Brand (Full Time, $1,500/mo)

Type of Work: Full Time

Salary: $1,500 USD / month

Hours per Week: 40

Job Category: Video Editing / Multimedia

About the role

We are a fast-growing DTC fashion brand and we run paid social at volume. We are hiring a full-time video editor who lives in AI tooling and can turn a brief plus a reference ad into a finished, scroll-stopping video.

This is a real editing job, not a "learn AI on the job" job. Almost everything we ship is AI-generated: AI avatars, AI voiceover, AI b-roll, AI product motion. You will be handed a script, a reference ad, and product references, and you are expected to come back with an ad that holds attention from second one to the last frame.

Every AI tool is provided and paid for by us. You never pay for a credit.

What you'll do

Ship around 5 net new concepts per day for TikTok, Meta, and YouTube Shorts, working from scripts and briefs we give you. These are short: most land between 10 and 35 seconds

Generate assets with AI tools: avatars, voiceover, b-roll, product motion, lip sync

Replicate references. When we send a reference ad plus a brief, you match its pacing, structure, and energy for our product without copying it frame for frame

Cut for retention: strong first 2 seconds, tight pacing, no dead air, a visual change every few seconds

Build hooks that stop the scroll, both the visual and the on-screen text

Add captions, sound design, music, and text overlays that feel native to the platform

Iterate fast on feedback and keep files organized so the team can find anything

What the work is actually like

The generation itself is fast and cheap. Our tools do the heavy lifting, the prompts and workflows are already built, and the briefs are detailed. The work is simple and repeatable once you know the system. What we are paying for is speed, taste, and consistency: hitting the daily count without the quality sliding, and knowing which cut holds a viewer and which one loses them.

You're a good fit if

You are extremely comfortable with AI creative tools

You can execute across multiple formats and styles

You understand pacing, hooks, visual storytelling, and direct-response editing

You can take a reference and recreate the format without needing your hand held

You are FAST and can handle consistent creative volume

That last one matters most. Around 5 finished concepts per day is the standard here. The work itself is simple once you know the system, but you have to be able to hold the pace without the quality sliding.

Requirements

2 to 3 years minimum of professional video editing experience (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or equivalent)

Hands-on experience with AI video and audio tools. We use HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Veo 3, Google Omni, and Seedance 2. You should already be working in several of these, and you should be able to pick up the rest quickly

You have edited AI-generated assets for a fashion or apparel brand before. This is required, not a bonus. Fashion has a specific look, and generic AI product video does not sell handbags

Direct-response instinct. You know why a viewer drops off at 3 seconds and you know how to fix it. Most of our ads are 10 to 35 seconds, so every single second has to earn its place

You can build a hook, not just execute one someone handed you

Comfortable working inside a team with daily communication, shared feedback, and revision rounds

Reliable full-time availability and strong written English

Bonus points

You have edited creatives that have spent serious money on Meta or TikTok. If you have, tell us the spend level and what the ad was

Motion graphics and color grading

Experience with UGC-style creator ads

Pay and structure

$1,500 USD per month, full time, long term

40 hours per week. Heavier concept weeks can run longer, and those weeks are the exception, not the norm

100% remote

All AI tools, software, and credits provided

Paid trial task before the final offer

How to apply

Applications missing any of these four items are deleted unread.

Record a Loom video, 5 to 8 minutes, and send us the link. In it: introduce yourself and your background as an editor, show 2 or 3 ads you personally edited that you are proud of and tell us why they worked, then walk us through your AI workflow (which tools you use, what you use each one for, and how you go from brief to finished ad). Screen share is encouraged. We want to see how you actually work

Link your portfolio or reel, with the fashion and AI-generated work called out specifically

Tell us your timezone and how many hours per week you can commit

Our hiring process

You send the Loom and portfolio

If it's a fit, we schedule a culture call where we get to know each other and you can ask us anything

Paid trial task on real work

Offer

We move quickly. If your Loom is strong, you will hear from us within a few days.

title: Inventory Manager
description:
Velantra is a fast-growing, multi-seven-figure e-commerce brand specializing in affordable luxury handbags and accessories. We've served tens of thousands of customers and are continuing to scale our operations.



We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Inventory & Supply Chain Manager to take ownership of our inventory operations, supplier coordination, and stock forecasting.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands e-commerce operations and can build reliable systems to ensure we always have the right products in stock, avoid costly inventory mistakes, and maintain smooth fulfillment.



Key Responsibilities



Inventory Management & Forecasting



Monitor inventory levels across all products, SKUs, colors, and variations.



Forecast inventory requirements based on historical sales, current demand, and projected growth.



Establish reorder points and maintain appropriate safety stock levels.



Identify slow-moving products, overstock, and potential stockouts.



Maintain accurate, up-to-date inventory tracking dashboards.



Supplier & 3PL Coordination



Communicate directly with our manufacturers, suppliers, and third-party logistics (3PL) partners.



Track purchase orders, production schedules, shipments, and delivery timelines.



Verify that incoming shipments match purchase orders, including correct SKUs, colors, quantities, and specifications.



Coordinate quality-control checks before inventory is shipped or received.



Resolve inventory discrepancies, incorrect shipments, and fulfillment issues.



Operational Reporting & Optimization



Provide weekly inventory reports covering stock levels, sell-through rates, projected stockouts, and upcoming replenishment needs.



Maintain accurate inventory records within Shopify and our internal tracking systems.



Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) for inventory management.



Identify opportunities to reduce inventory carrying costs, improve forecasting, and streamline supply chain operations.



Work closely with the founder to plan inventory requirements for product launches and promotional campaigns.



Requirements



2+ years of experience in inventory management, supply chain operations, or e-commerce operations.



Experience working with Shopify-based e-commerce brands.



Strong proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel.



Experience coordinating with overseas manufacturers, suppliers, or 3PL warehouses.



Understanding of inventory forecasting, purchase orders, lead times, and reorder planning.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Extremely detail-oriented, proactive, and organized.



Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of operational processes.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience managing inventory for a fashion, accessories, or consumer goods brand.



Familiarity with Chinese manufacturers and international freight.



Experience with inventory management software, ERP systems, or automated reporting.



Experience supporting a high-volume, seven-figure e-commerce business.



What We're Looking For



We don't want someone who simply updates spreadsheets.



We want someone who takes full ownership of inventory, proactively identifies potential problems, and solves them before they impact the business.



You should be comfortable analyzing data, communicating with suppliers, and developing systems that can support a rapidly scaling e-commerce operation.



Accuracy, accountability, and proactive communication are essential.



Compensation & Benefits



Competitive monthly salary based on experience.



Fully remote position.



Long-term growth opportunities as the company scales.



Direct collaboration with the founder.



Opportunity to build and manage critical operational systems.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume and relevant inventory management experience.



A brief description of the e-commerce brands you've worked with, including their approximate size and order volume.



The inventory management tools and systems you've used.



Your expected monthly salary in USD.



Important: Begin your application with the word VELANTRA so we know you've read the full job description.



We're looking for someone who can grow with the company and become a key member of our operations team.

title: Experienced Meta Ads Media Buyer – E-commerce & Lead Generation (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
# Hiring: Meta Ads Media Buyer – E-commerce & Lead Generation (Part-Time, Remote)



**Job Type:** Part-Time, Long-Term

**Compensation:** US$6/hour

**Working Hours:** Approximately 10 hours per week initially, with opportunities for increased hours

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability for meetings during Eastern Time (Canada)



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and results-driven **Meta Ads Media Buyer** to manage and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns for businesses targeting the Canadian and North American markets.



Our initial focus is on an established Canadian e-commerce business specializing in premium baby gifts. Over the next 3–6 months, we plan to expand into lead generation campaigns for online coaches, consultants, and personal development businesses.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience generating profitable e-commerce sales and qualified leads through Meta advertising.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of campaign performance, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and help us scale advertising profitably.



**This is a long-term opportunity for the right candidate to grow with us.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Meta Ads Campaign Management



- Plan, set up, launch, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Develop advertising strategies for e-commerce sales and lead generation.

- Research and test audiences, placements, campaign structures, and targeting approaches.

- Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven adjustments.

- Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize return on investment.

- Identify winning campaigns and implement strategies for profitable scaling.



### 2. Ad Creative Strategy & Testing



- Research competitors and identify successful advertising approaches.

- Develop compelling ad copy, headlines, and calls to action.

- Recommend effective creative concepts, including images, videos, and carousel ads.

- Conduct structured A/B testing of ad creatives, messaging, and offers.

- Analyze creative performance and recommend improvements.

- Work with existing brand assets and coordinate additional creative requirements with the business owner.



### 3. E-commerce Advertising



- Manage Meta Ads campaigns focused on generating online purchases.

- Optimize campaigns for ROAS, cost per purchase, and profitability.

- Identify potential audiences and effective advertising angles.

- Analyze the customer journey from ad click to purchase.

- Recommend strategies to improve conversion performance and scale successful campaigns.



### 4. Lead Generation Advertising



- Plan and manage lead generation campaigns for coaches, consultants, and online businesses.

- Develop advertising strategies for webinars, workshops, online courses, consultations, and other lead generation offers.

- Optimize campaigns for cost per lead (CPL), lead quality, and customer acquisition.

- Test different audiences, messaging, offers, and creative approaches.

- Collaborate with the business owner to improve funnel performance and lead conversion rates.



### 5. Tracking, Analytics & Optimization



- Set up, review, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.

- Understand Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and conversion event optimization.

- Track and analyze important metrics, including:

  - ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)

  - CPA (Cost per Acquisition)

  - CPL (Cost per Lead)

  - CTR (Click-Through Rate)

  - CPC (Cost per Click)

  - CPM (Cost per 1,000 Impressions)

  - Conversion rates

- Identify performance issues and recommend solutions.

- Make optimization decisions based on meaningful conversion data rather than vanity metrics.

- Provide concise weekly performance reports covering campaign results, key metrics, and advertising spend.

- Clearly explain what is working, what is not, and what actions are being taken.

- Recommend new tests, budget adjustments, and growth opportunities.

- Communicate proactively about campaign performance and potential issues.

- Participate in occasional online meetings to review results and discuss strategy.



## Requirements



**Must Have:**



- Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.

- Proven experience running successful Shopify or similar e-commerce advertising campaigns.

- Experience managing lead generation campaigns, preferably for coaches, consultants, online courses, or service-based businesses.

- Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and conversion-focused advertising strategies.

- Demonstrated ability to optimize campaigns for ROAS, CPA, CPL, and profitability.

- Experience with audience research, creative testing, campaign optimization, and scaling.

- Familiarity with Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines.

- Reliable internet connection and availability for regular communication.



**Nice to Have:**



- Experience targeting Canadian and US audiences.

- Experience advertising premium consumer products or gift-related products.

- Experience promoting webinars, workshops, and coaching programs.

- Basic Canva or video editing skills for adapting existing advertising creatives.

- Familiarity with Shopify Analytics and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

- Experience managing multiple advertising accounts.



**Please Note:** Visuals, landing page development, CRM management, and
/SMS automations are NOT required for this role. These will be handled separately. Your primary focus will be Meta advertising performance.



## What We Offer



- **US$6/hour**, paid based on hours worked.

- Approximately 10 hours per week initially.

- Flexible working schedule.

- Fully remote position.

- Long-term opportunity with the potential for increased hours and responsibilities.

- Opportunity to work on both e-commerce and coaching/lead generation campaigns.

- Direct communication and collaboration with the business owner.

- Existing marketing assets, product images, and brand materials to support advertising campaigns.

- Opportunity to contribute ideas, develop advertising strategies, and grow professionally.



## How to Apply

**1. Meta Ads Experience**



How many years have you been managing Meta Ads campaigns? Briefly describe the types of businesses you have worked with.



**2. E-commerce Results**

- Monthly advertising spend

- Product or industry

- ROAS achieved

- Cost per purchase (CPA)

- Your role in achieving the results

If yes, please provide an example, including advertising spend, CPL, and lead quality or conversion results.



**4. Campaign Strategy**



If you were given a monthly Meta Ads budget of C$2,000 for a Canadian e-commerce brand, how would you approach the first 30 days?



Please provide a brief overview of your strategy.



**5. Availability & Compensation**



Are you comfortable working approximately 10 hours per week at US$6/hour? Are you available for weekly meetings during Canadian Eastern Time?



**6. Portfolio**



Please share relevant case studies, campaign screenshots, or examples of advertising accounts you have managed. You may hide confidential client information.

We are looking for a **performance-focused media buyer**, not a general social media manager or someone whose primary experience is boosting
 posts.

title: Part-Time Automotive Call Center Representative
description:

Remote | U.S. Central Time Hours | Automotive Appointment Setting



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are looking for a dependable, professional, and personable Part-Time Call Center Representative to join our automotive marketing team.



Our company works with automotive dealerships throughout the United States. Your primary responsibility will be speaking with customers and setting appointments for participating dealerships.

Spanish-speaking applicants are strongly encouraged to apply and receive higher compensation.

Follow company-provided call scripts and procedures

Worked together in one block, OR



Spread throughout the day

Saturday Availability

Flexibility, reliability, and punctuality are important for this position.



COMPENSATION

$250 USD per month

We want someone who is:

Friendly and personable



Confident and professional



Able to build rapport quickly

A good listener

Reliable and punctual



Detail-oriented

Coachable and willing to improve

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS

You must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based customers.



Spanish



Spanish is a PLUS and receives higher compensation.



Applicants applying for the bilingual position should be comfortable carrying on a complete customer conversation in Spanish—not simply speaking basic or conversational Spanish.



WORK-FROM-HOME REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



Reliable high-speed internet



Reliable computer



Quality headset with microphone



Quiet work environment



Minimal background noise during customer calls



Ability to consistently work your assigned hours



TRAINING



Training will be provided on:



Automotive campaigns



Call scripts



Appointment-setting procedures



CRM usage



Customer handling



Call documentation

We provide the systems, scripts, and procedures. We expect the successful candidate to learn quickly, accept coaching, and consistently apply what they have been taught.



HOW TO APPLY

We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term part-time position who will take their schedule and responsibilities seriously.

title: AI Cinematic Film Director & Producer — Original YouTube Movies
description:

Production Budget: $1,500–$3,000 USD per completed film



About the Project



We are launching What Changed Us, an original cinematic storytelling channel on YouTube featuring emotionally powerful films about love, family, sacrifice, unexpected relationships, betrayal, redemption, and the moments that change people's lives.



Our goal is to produce beautiful, realistic, emotionally compelling movies—not generic AI slideshows, animated photo sequences, or narrated stock footage.



Our first original film, The Woman Who Raised My Sons, explores extraordinary love, family, sacrifice, and the meaning of motherhood.



We are searching for a talented, creative, and independent AI filmmaker who can help bring our stories to life.



Who We're Looking For



We need someone who understands filmmaking, not simply AI video generation.



The ideal candidate can:



- Transform original stories and screenplays into cinematic films.

- Direct believable human performances with expressive emotions and natural movements.

- Maintain consistent character faces, appearances, voices, and environments across scenes.

- Develop compelling cinematography, camera movements, lighting, and scene transitions.

- Produce natural English dialogue, voice performances, music, and professional sound design.

- Handle AI scene generation, editing, pacing, and final production.

- Work independently, solve production challenges, and offer creative recommendations.

- Collaborate with the story creator while respecting the original artistic vision.



Experience with AI filmmaking tools and professional editing software is important. Demonstrated cinematic storytelling ability matters more than any particular software.



Production Budget and Expectations



Our initial budget is approximately $1,500–$3,000 per completed film, depending on the proposed scope and deliverables.



We envision approximately 35–45 minutes for our first movie, but we're open to recommendations regarding realistic production length and quality within our budget.



We want you to tell us what you can deliver.



Rather than automatically selecting the lowest bid, we will evaluate production quality, storytelling ability, artistic direction, proposed runtime, and overall value.



Proposals should identify what is included in the fixed project price, including AI generation costs, voices, music, editing, revisions, and final deliverables.



Our intention is to build a lasting production relationship. As the channel grows and earns audience engagement, opportunities for larger production budgets may become available.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Links to your two strongest completed cinematic storytelling projects, preferably involving realistic human characters and emotional scenes.

2. Your exact role in creating those films.

3. The AI filmmaking and editing tools you use.

4. An explanation of your character consistency and emotional performance workflow.

5. Your proposed film length, deliverables, estimated production schedule, and fixed-price quote within our $1,500–$3,000 budget.

6. Whether you can independently manage production from approved script through final edit.



Shortlisted filmmakers may be invited to complete a separate, agreed fixed-price paid cinematic evaluation before any full-film contract is offered.



Please begin your application with the words "Every Person Has a Story" so we know you've read the complete posting.



We welcome emerging filmmakers as well as experienced creative directors. What matters most is your ability to tell a story that moves people.



We look forward to discovering our next creative filmmaking partner.

title: Part-Time Content Researcher & Scriptwriter – Anti-Aging Newsletter
description:
Amy's is launching a new anti-aging and healthy-longevity newsletter, and we're hiring a part-time content researcher & scriptwriter to power it. Work starts part-time / assignment-based. If you show and prove to be an asset, we will ask you to become salaried.



What you'll do:

- Research anti-aging and longevity topics with real viral potential — what's working on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube right now, and why

- Write newsletter issues (we're aiming for 5 per month to start) in a tight, engaging style — see the examples below

- Write short-form video hooks and scripts (30–59 seconds) for our video editor, based on your research

- Track what's performing and double down on what works



The style we want — study these before applying:

- James Clear's "3-2-1" newsletter: short, scannable, one sharp idea per section. We want that discipline.

- Tim Ferriss's "5-Bullet Friday": curated, punchy, personality-driven. We want that energy.

- Peter Attia's newsletter: evidence-based health content that respects the reader's intelligence. We want that credibility.

We want the best of all three: short, credible, and impossible to skim past.



What we're looking for:

- Excellent English writing — this is a writing-first role

- Genuine interest in health, longevity, and the anti-aging space

- Strong research skills: you can find primary sources and separate real science from hype

- You understand how newsletters actually grow — lead magnets, referral loops, welcome sequences, highly shareable issues — not just how to write them

- You can write a hook that stops a scroll



Hours & pay: Part-time to start, assignment-based. Pay at market rate based on your ability — please include your rate when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS FIRST:

Most applicants skim job posts. We need people who don't. To prove you read this entire post, start your application message with this exact phrase: "WRITER Amy's sent me"

Applications that don't start with those exact four words will not be reviewed. No exceptions, no hard feelings — we just need people who follow instructions. (Starting with WRITER tells us you're applying for the researcher/writer role.)



Then answer these 5 questions in your application:

1. Which of the three example newsletters above best fits what we're building, and why (2–3 sentences)?

2. Share links to 2–3 writing samples (newsletter, blog, or video scripts — health topics preferred).

3. Name one anti-aging topic you think would go viral right now, and why.

4. What's one newsletter growth tactic you'd recommend for a brand-new publication?

5. What hours (Philippine time) are you generally available to work?



TEST PROJECT (required — we hire based on this):

1. Write a 250–350 word newsletter section on ONE anti-aging food or habit, in the style of the examples above. Pick something with viral potential and make the first line unskippable.

2. Write 3 one-line video hooks (under 12 words each) for the same topic — hooks for a 30–59 second vertical video.

Submit both with your application, as plain text or a Google Doc link. We hire based on the quality of this test: writing skill, research depth, and hook-writing ability. AI-generated spam is an instant reject — we can tell.



---



TEST PROJECT 2 (required — we hire based on this too):

We publish a monthly roundup of Vancouver birthday freebies: 

1. Write an Instagram caption (under 150 words) announcing this month's birthday freebies roundup — hook in the first line, tease 3 freebies, end with a call to action to visit the link in bio.

2. Write a 100-word newsletter blurb for the same roundup.

Both should make people want to click, not just inform them. Submit as plain text with your application. We hire based on hook-writing and how clickable the copy feels.



---

description:
Amy's is hiring a part-time virtual assistant to help run the online side of our business. Work starts part-time / assignment-based. If you show and prove to be an asset, we will ask you to become salaried.



What you'll do:

- Publish and schedule content — we aim to publish 5 articles per month

- Website maintenance and incremental updates on Squarespace

- Create, manage, and update funnels and pages in ClickFunnels

- Check stats (traffic, funnel performance) and report on them regularly

- General admin and maintenance tasks as needed



What we're looking for:

- Hands-on experience with ClickFunnels (building and editing funnels/pages)

- Hands-on experience with Squarespace (updating pages, posts, and settings)

- Strong written English — writing ability is a big plus and will be prioritized

- Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working independently

- Comfortable reading basic analytics and summarizing what matters



Hours & pay: Part-time to start, assignment-based. Pay at market rate based on your ability — please include your rate when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS FIRST:

Most applicants skim job posts. We need people who don't. To prove you read this entire post, start your application message with this exact phrase: "ADMIN Amy's sent me"

Applications that don't start with those exact four words will not be reviewed. No exceptions, no hard feelings — we just need people who follow instructions. (Starting with ADMIN tells us you're applying for the admin role.)



Then answer these 5 questions in your application:

1. Describe your experience with ClickFunnels — what have you built or managed?

2. Describe your experience with Squarespace — what have you built or maintained?

3. Please share a writing sample or links to articles/posts you've written.

4. How would you track and report funnel and website stats on a weekly basis?

5. What hours (Philippine time) are you generally available to work?



---



TEST PROJECT (required — we hire based on this):

We maintain a directory of Vancouver birthday freebies here: 

1. Find 3 birthday freebies in Vancouver that are NOT currently on our page.

2. Verify each one: what exactly is free, how to claim it (ID? app? sign-up?), and any conditions or expiry.

3. Write a 2–3 sentence directory entry for each, matching the style and format of the existing page.

Submit your 3 entries as plain text with your application. We hire based on research quality, accuracy, and how well you match the page's format. Write the entries in your own words — do not copy text from other websites.



---

title: Video Editor for YouTube – Long-Form + Short-Form (Part-Time)
description:
Amy's is looking for a talented video editor to join our team part-time. Work starts on an assignment basis. If you show and prove to be an asset, we will ask you to become salaried.



What you'll do:

- Edit long-form YouTube videos: clean cuts, pacing, b-roll, captions, sound leveling, and engaging intros

- Repurpose long-form content into short-form clips for TikTok and YouTube Shorts (strong hooks, captions, vertical formatting)

- Follow brand style and feedback to deliver polished, on-brand videos

- Hit agreed turnaround times consistently



What we're looking for:

- Proven experience editing YouTube videos — both long-form AND short-form (portfolio required)

- Proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut — tell us your stack

- Strong sense of pacing, retention, and what makes short-form content hook viewers

- Good written English and communication — you take feedback and run with it

- Reliable internet and your own editing setup



Nice to have: motion graphics / basic animation, thumbnail design experience.



Hours & pay: Part-time to start (hours vary by assignment). Hourly pay at market rate, based on your skill and experience — please include your rate when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS FIRST:

Most applicants skim job posts. We need people who don't. To prove you read this entire post, start your application message with this exact phrase: "VIDEO Amy's sent me"

Applications that don't start with those exact four words will not be reviewed. No exceptions, no hard feelings — we just need people who follow instructions. (Starting with VIDEO tells us you're applying for the video editor role.)



Then answer these 5 questions in your application:

1. Please share links to 2–3 videos you've edited (at least one long-form and one short-form).

2. What editing software do you use?

3. Roughly how long would a 10-minute talking-head YouTube video take you to edit?

4. Are you comfortable turning one long video into 3–5 short-form clips?

5. What hours (Philippine time) are you generally available to work?



---



TEST PROJECT (required — we hire based on this):

Pick ONE of the 5 topics below and produce the video as briefed. Submit the finished video file or a viewable link with your application, along with your answers to the questions above. We will choose who to hire based on the quality of this test video: editing skill, pacing, the hook, and how well you followed the brief.



Topic 1 — "5 Foods That Slow Aging (Eat This Much Daily)"

Countdown from 5 to 1. Each food gets its exact daily amount in big on-screen text (for example: "2 kiwis daily — vitamin C for collagen"). End card: "Follow for part 2."



Topic 2 — "3 Things Secretly Aging You vs 3 That Fight Back"

Three contrast pairs (for example: soda vs green tea). Show each "aging" item with a red X, then its fix with a green check. Fast cuts, one pair every ~5 seconds.



Topic 3 — "You're a Chicken Cooking in an Oven"

Explain glycation with this analogy: sugar binding to protein ages you like a chicken browning in an oven. Then give 3 quick hacks (eat vegetables first, walk after meals, a spoon of vinegar before eating). Educational with a slightly funny tone.



Topic 4 — "2 Body Processes That D
 How Fast You Age"

Cover autophagy (the body recycling damaged cells — supported by mushrooms / fasting) and mitophagy (mitochondria cleanup — supported by berries). Use simple visuals or stock footage; keep jargon minimal and explain every term on screen.



Topic 5 — "7 Foods That Boost Nitric Oxide"

Hook: nitric oxide keeps arteries young and it drops as you age. Count down 7 foods (beet juice, arugula, garlic, dark chocolate, citrus, pomegranate, fermented foods) with bold numbers on screen.



Topic 6 — "Birthday Freebies in Vancouver" (make a boring topic unskippable)

Every month we post a roundup of free birthday perks at Vancouver restaurants and shops — free appetizers, meals, desserts (full directory: 
) — but these posts aren't getting traction. Your job: turn this into a 30–59 second vertical video people can't scroll past. Hook in the first 2 seconds (for example: "Born this month? Vancouver restaurants owe you free food"), then rapid-fire 3–5 freebies with big on-screen text, and end with "Link in bio for the full directory." Clean, modern Western editing style — no overdone effects.



Topic 7 — "Helium Balloons: Need to Know"

We sell and inflate helium balloons — giant foil numbers, shimmering chrome balloons — with walk-in inflation at our Davie Street store in Vancouver's West End. No reservation needed, just drop by. Turn this into a 30–59 second vertical video teaching viewers what they need to know before buying party balloons: how long they float, foil vs latex, and that they can walk into Amy's on Davie and get them inflated on the spot. Hook in the first 2 seconds (for example: "Stop! Don't buy party balloons until you know this"), quick punchy tips with big on-screen text, end with "Walk-ins welcome at Amy's on Davie." Clean, modern Western editing style — no overdone effects.



SPECS (all topics): 30–59 seconds, vertical 9:16, big readable captions throughout, the hook must land in the first 2 seconds, trending-style pacing. You may use stock footage and AI/text-to-speech voiceover — you do not need to appear on camera. No watermarks.



---



TEST PROJECT 2 (required — we hire based on this too):

Download the raw interview footage here: 

Cut it into a TikTok-ready clip (30–59 seconds, vertical 9:16). Study this example of the finished style we're after: 

Requirements: hook in the first 2 seconds, clean readable captions throughout, tight pacing. This video is for a Western audience (Canada/USA) — use a clean, modern Western social-media editing style. No overdone effects, flashy transitions, or cluttered graphics.

Submit the finished video file or a viewable link with your application.



---



TEST VIDEO PAYMENT TERMS (please read before submitting):

The test videos you submit with your application are unpaid. However — if we select your video because we like it and want to use it, we will pay you $20-$25 for it. Simple as that: submit your best work, and if it's good enough to publish, you get paid.

title: AI-Assisted Customer Support Lead <email class=
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women across the US. Orders are growing fast, and we need one person to own customer support from end to end.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and d
 what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own the result. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ What you will own

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups and creator partnerships fill the rest of your shift.



1. Customer support 
, AI-assisted)

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our
 and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.

• Answer DMs.



3. Supplier and fulfillment communication

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Influencer and creator partnerships

• Reach out to content creators and influencers, and follow up.

• Coordinate product shipments and track the content we receive.



As the owner of the department, you will also:

• Suggest improvements to our reply rules, templates and SOPs (step-by-step guides).

• Report recurring problems (product, shipping, website) to the founder, with a suggested fix.

• Train and lead new agents later, if the team grows.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week, 7 hours of work a day. Your day off is fixed and agreed together (any day except Sunday and Monday).

• Early morning shift: 6:00 AM to about 1:00 PM Philippine time (a 7:00 AM start is possible). It's still evening in the US, so you are there when our customers are active.

• Plus about 1 hour in the evening to check new tickets and comments. 7 hours of work a day in total.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote. Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You own the result, you follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience as a team lead or senior agent.

• Bonus: experience with influencer or content creator (UGC) outreach.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 Competitive monthly salary, paid on time, every month. Strong experience gets the top of the range.

📊 Performance bonuses.

🚀 A real growth path: grow into Customer Support Manager, and beyond (for example operations) if you want more responsibility.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder.

🌴 100% remote. Early shift: most of your work is done by early afternoon.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.



➤ A word from the founder

I am looking for someone with a brain, who takes responsibility. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, you are 100% autonomous. I don't double-check your work, because you handle it and I trust you. Every
 and every comment gets answered on time, every day. Nothing gets forgotten. If there is a problem, I hear about it from you first.

In return: your salary grows over time, you earn performance bonuses, and you take on more responsibility as the brand grows.



➤ How to apply

Apply through this form: 

Applications sent any other way will not be considered.



➤ Our hiring process

1. Application form

2. Quick video interview with the founder

3. You start. The first week is a paid trial week, then it's a long-term role

title: Practice Administrator | Australian Accounting Firm | Xero Practice Manager
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an organised and detail-oriented Practice Administrator to support an Australian accounting firm.



This role is primarily administrative. You will help manage client records, workflows, deadlines, onboarding, compliance documentation and day-to-day practice operations. You will also assist with invoicing, payment follow-ups and client communications.



The ideal candidate has at least 2 years of administration experience in an Australian accounting practice and understands how accounting firms manage client information, compliance deadlines and practice workflows.



You do not need to be responsible for preparing tax returns or performing complex accounting work. Instead, you will help ensure that administrative tasks are completed accurately, deadlines are monitored, documents are collected and work is ready for the Director's review and approval.



Key Responsibilities



Practice Administration and Workflow Management



Maintain client jobs, workflow stages, task statuses and due dates in Xero Practice Manager (XPM).



Monitor deadlines and follow up on outstanding tasks to keep work progressing.



Ensure client and entity details, including names, ABNs, ACNs and relevant dates, are accurate across systems.



Maintain organised client records, compliance checklists and electronic filing systems.



Track documents requiring signatures and ensure completed documents are saved correctly.



Client Onboarding and Documentation



Assist with onboarding new clients by collecting required information and supporting documents.



Coordinate identity verification, customer due diligence and conflict-check documentation.



Prepare engagement letters and related documents from templates for Director review and approval.



Follow up on outstanding information, signed documents and prior-year accounting records.



Assist with client-agent linking through ATO Online Services for agents, where required.



ASIC and Company Administration



Monitor ASIC annual review dates and prepare the relevant documentation for review and approval.



Coordinate signing documents and follow up on outstanding requirements.



Prepare draft company forms, including Forms 484 and 362, based on approved instructions.



Maintain company registers, officeholder details and corporate records.



Assist with preparing minutes, resolutions, dividend statements and share transfer documentation using templates.



Invoicing and Client Communication



Prepare client invoices in Xero Practice Manager and follow up on overdue payments.



Draft routine client
s, including requests for information, signing reminders and tax payment notifications, for Director approval.



Assist with diary management, appointment scheduling and client follow-ups.



Coordinate with external service providers when documentation or additional information is required.



Quality Checks and General Administration



Review automated or AI-assisted outputs for accurate client details, dates, amounts and supporting information.



Ensure documents are complete, properly filed and ready for review before anything is sent externally.



Help maintain efficient administrative processes and ensure outstanding items are followed through.



Required Experience and Skills



At least 2 years of administration experience within an Australian accounting practice.



Practical experience using Xero Practice Manager (XPM) to manage client records, jobs, workflows or deadlines.



Familiarity with Xero and the general administrative processes of an Australian accounting firm.



Understanding of ATO client-agent linking and ATO Online Services for agents.



Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients, tasks and deadlines.



Excellent attention to detail when checking client information and preparing documents.



Clear written English and professional client communication skills.



Confidence following up on outstanding information, documents and payments.



Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive client information.



Highly Regarded



Hands-on experience with ASIC annual reviews and company secretarial administration.



Experience preparing draft ASIC Forms 484 and 362, maintaining company registers, and preparing minutes or resolutions.



Familiarity with engagement letters, client onboarding and identity verification procedures.



Experience with electronic signing platforms such as SignNow or similar.



Familiarity with Microsoft 365, OneDrive and AI-assisted administrative workflows.



Certificate IV in Accounting and Bookkeeping or a related qualification.



Important Note



This is a practice administration role, not a Senior Accountant or tax preparation position. We are looking for someone who understands the administrative operations of an Australian accounting practice and can manage workflows, documentation, client follow-ups and compliance deadlines accurately.



How to Apply



Please submit your updated CV and include brief answers to the following questions:



How many years of administration experience do you have working in an Australian accounting practice?



Which accounting practice management systems have you used, particularly Xero Practice Manager (XPM)?



Have you personally managed client workflows, deadlines and outstanding document follow-ups in an accounting firm? Please provide examples.

When would you be available to start?



Please send your application to 
 with the subject line: Admin KA – Your Full Name.

title: Video Editor (Long Term Position)
description:
Video Editor – YouTube, Reels & Short-Form Content (Long-Term Position)



Company: Peakfinity Labs  

Website: 
  

Position: Video Editor  

Job Type: Full-Time / Long-Term  

Location: Remote



About Us



Peakfinity Labs is a supplement and cosmetic contract manufacturing company helping eCommerce entrepreneurs build, launch, and scale their own brands.



We work with Shopify brands, Amazon sellers, TikTok Shop entrepreneurs, and established businesses to develop and manufacture high-quality products.



We're building a strong presence across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X by producing educational, engaging content about eCommerce, entrepreneurship, supplement manufacturing, and building successful consumer brands.



This isn't a position where you'll simply cut clips and add subtitles. We want someone who understands storytelling, pacing, viewer psychology, and how to keep an audience engaged.



What You'll Be Doing



- Editing short-form and long form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and X.

- Editing longer educational YouTube videos, interviews, and company content.

- Turning raw talking-head footage into engaging, professionally edited videos.

- Creating attention-grabbing hooks within the first few seconds.

- Adding clean, modern captions, motion graphics, B-roll, animations, and sound effects where appropriate.

- Incorporating footage from our manufacturing facilities, laboratories, production lines, and warehouses.

- Finding relevant B-roll, screenshots, graphics, and visual examples to support what's being discussed.

- Removing unnecessary pauses, filler words, and sections that hurt pacing.

- Repurposing long-form videos into multiple short-form clips.

- Maintaining consistent branding, typography, and editing styles.

- Organizing project files and managing multiple video projects.

- Working with our team to continuously improve editing quality and audience retention.



What We're Looking For



Required Skills:



- Strong experience editing short-form social media content.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software.

- Ability to create motion graphics using After Effects or equivalent tools.

- Excellent understanding of pacing, storytelling, and audience retention.

- Experience editing talking-head videos, educational content, or business-related videos.

- Ability to use B-roll, visual storytelling, and graphics to make complex subjects easy to understand.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly with audio, captions, and transitions.

- Ability to follow creative direction while also contributing your own ideas.

- Good English comprehension and communication skills.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to meet deadlines consistently.



Bonus Skills:



- Experience editing YouTube videos for business or educational creators.

- Experience with direct-response advertising or eCommerce brands.

- Understanding of YouTube analytics, retention graphs, and content performance.

- Experience with AI-powered editing tools.

- Ability to create professional thumbnails.

- Experience with color grading and audio enhancement.

- Familiarity with content from business creators such as Alex Hormozi or similar educational channels.



Our Editing Style



We're looking for clean, modern, professional editing that prioritizes viewer engagement. We will provide examples.



Our content includes:



- Educational videos explaining how supplement manufacturing works.

- Behind-the-scenes footage of real manufacturing facilities.

- Business and eCommerce advice for entrepreneurs.

- Founder-led talking-head videos.

- Industry breakdowns and comparisons.

- Interviews, discussions, and longer YouTube videos.



We want videos that feel polished and credible while still being entertaining.



We do NOT want excessive transitions, unnecessary animations, or distracting effects every two seconds.



Every edit should have a purpose.



The goal is to make complicated subjects interesting, keep viewers watching, and establish Peakfinity Labs as a trusted authority in the manufacturing industry.



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?



We're looking for an editor who thinks beyond simply completing an assigned video.



A great candidate will:



- Recognize when a section of footage is boring and know how to improve it.

- Understand how the first 3 seconds influence short-form video performance.

- Know when to use B-roll, graphics, or a simple clean cut.

- Be comfortable suggesting improvements to pacing and structure.

- Understand the difference between editing for TikTok and editing for YouTube.

- Take ownership of their work without needing constant supervision.

- Be interested in improving their skills and growing alongside our company.



What We Offer



- Long-term, consistent work with a growing company.

- Opportunity to work on a variety of interesting video projects.

- Creative freedom to contribute ideas and improve our content.

- Clear direction, organized workflows, and constructive feedback.

- Opportunities for increased responsibility as our content operation expands.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and skill level.



We're looking to build a long-term relationship with the right person, not hire someone for a handful of videos.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your portfolio: Send a link to your previous video editing work. YouTube, Google Drive, Vimeo, or a personal portfolio website are all acceptable.

2. Relevant experience: Briefly describe your experience editing short-form videos, YouTube content, or educational/business videos.

3. Software:Which editing programs do you primarily use?

4. Availability: Are you available for full-time work? How many hours per week can you commit?

5. Your strongest work: Which 2–3 existing videos in your portfolio best demonstrate your editing abilities, and why?



Important: We're particularly interested in editors who have experience making educational or talking-head content engaging. Please prioritize relevant examples in your portfolio.



We're excited to find someone who wants to grow with Peakfinity Labs and help us build a high-quality content operation.

title: Ongoing 3D Sculptor for Fantasy Hair Crowns — $25 per Design (Remote)
description:
About us



Fable & Crown creates sculptural back crowns: detailed hairpieces that curve around the back of the head, are 3D printed, and are finished by hand. Our collection draws on woodland creatures, sweeping wings, antlers, Celtic ornament, botanical forms, and gothic fantasy — wearable art for Renaissance faires, fantasy weddings, and everyday storybook magic.



See our visual direction: 



The work



This is ongoing, per-design sculpting work — not a one-off. We start with ONE paid sample design ($25). If it meets our quality bar, you get steady ongoing work at $25 per completed design, with new briefs on a regular basis.



Payment: per completed design, paid on delivery and acceptance.



Quality bar



- High-detail organic sculpting (creatures, ornament, botanical forms)

- Print-ready geometry: clean topology, watertight STL, proper wall thickness for FDM printing

- Designed to print with minimal to few supports

- Clean underside with space for comb attachment (dimensions agreed before modeling)



Beyond the briefs — the long-term play



We're looking for a creative partner, not just hands. As we build together, we want you bringing ideas to us: researching what's trending across movies, shows, and pop culture, mocking up concept renders (AI image tools are great for this), and pitching designs you'd be excited to sculpt. Every concept we greenlight becomes a paid design. The better your ideas, the more designs you get — this is how a $25/design gig grows into a real creative partnership.



Deliverables per design



- Approved, completed 3D sculpt

- Clean, watertight STL at the agreed size

- Editable native source file (ZBrush, Blender, or equivalent)

- Front, back, and side preview renders

- Multiple revision rounds within the agreed brief



Requirements



- Strong portfolio of organic/fantasy sculpting (this matters more than anything)

- ZBrush or Blender, with proven experience preparing models for 3D printing

- 2-day turnaround per design, with revisions within 24 hours

- Original work only — we require exclusive commercial ownership of final designs and source files. No resold marketplace models or unlicensed third-party assets.



To apply, answer all four:



1. Portfolio links — 3–5 examples of your sculpting, especially organic ornament, fantasy accessories, jewelry, creatures, or models you have successfully 3D printed. (Required — applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.)

2. Software you use and your experience preparing printable models.

3. Your estimated turnaround per design.

4. Our budget is $25 per completed design, including revisions and the deliverables above — let us know if that works for you.



Shortlisted candidates will receive reference sheets showing the level of sculpted detail and finish we expect.

title: NOW HIRING Senior Credit Repair Specialist | RESULTS-DRIVEN | Proven Deletions Required
description:
# NOW HIRING: ELITE CREDIT REPAIR SPECIALIST

**OPULENT CREDIT | REMOTE – PHILIPPINES**



**RESULTS-DRIVEN PROFESSIONALS ONLY | SERIOUS APPLICANTS**



Opulent Credit is a growing U.S.-based credit restoration and financial services company seeking an **elite, highly experienced, results-driven Credit Repair Specialist** to become an integral part of our expanding operation.



We are NOT hiring beginners, generic dispute processors, or individuals who simply generate letters and wait for results.



**WE NEED PROVEN SPECIALISTS WHO KNOW HOW TO EXECUTE AND DELIVER LEGITIMATE DELETIONS.**



We expect exceptional attention to detail, advanced dispute knowledge, strong organization, professional communication, and an unwavering commitment to results.



Our objective is to build a seamless, efficient, scalable credit restoration operation supported by exceptional professionals.



**If you cannot demonstrate successful dispute outcomes, independently manage client files, and execute with precision, this position is not for you.**



## PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: FAST, LEGITIMATE RESULTS



We are specifically seeking specialists with documented success obtaining **FIRST-ROUND AND SECOND-ROUND DELETIONS** where supported by reporting inaccuracies or other legitimate grounds.



Candidates must have demonstrated experience addressing:



- Charge-offs and collections

- Late payments and inaccurate payment histories

- Unauthorized or inaccurate hard inquiries

- Repossessions and derogatory accounts

- Incorrect balances, statuses, and reporting dates

- Duplicate accounts and inaccurate personal information

- Complex, multi-account credit profiles

- Straightforward profiles requiring targeted corrections



We expect candidates to know how to identify the strongest legitimate dispute grounds, prioritize actionable inaccuracies, and pursue timely deletions and corrections.



**Speed, precision, and measurable outcomes are essential.**



We do not accept unnecessary delays, unsupported disputes, generic letters, or repetitive work without a defined strategy.



We understand that bureaus and furnishers control investigation timelines and that accurate, verifiable information cannot simply be guaranteed for deletion. We expect the fastest lawful execution and strongest fact-supported strategy possible.



## REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERTISE



### Advanced Credit Report Analysis



You must independently analyze comprehensive three-bureau reports and identify:



- Inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable information

- Potential FCRA and FDCPA violations

- Relevant Metro 2 reporting discrepancies

- Incorrect payment histories and account statuses

- Improper dates, balances, and account details

- Appropriate grounds for bureau and furnisher disputes

- Opportunities for lawful reinvestigation, correction, or deletion



You must know **which legal requirement applies, why it applies, and how to use it appropriately**.



### First-Round and Second-Round Dispute Execution



Required capabilities include:



- Customized, fact-based dispute letters

- Strategic first-round and second-round dispute preparation

- Direct creditor and furnisher disputes

- Bureau reinvestigation procedures

- Method-of-verification requests where appropriate

- Debt validation requests where applicable

- Review and analysis of investigation responses

- Proper follow-up on unresolved inaccuracies

- Identification of incomplete or unreasonable investigations

- Thorough tracking of outcomes and deadlines



Every dispute must have a clear factual basis and a documented objective.



**Mass-produced, unsupported dispute letters are unacceptable.**



### FTC Reports, CFPB Complaints & Consumer Law



Candidates must understand:



- FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, and applicable credit reporting requirements

- Relevant Metro 2 reporting standards

- FTC identity theft reporting for legitimate, qualifying identity theft cases

- CFPB complaint preparation and escalation when warranted

- Supporting documentation and evidence requirements

- Proper handling of bureau and furnisher correspondence



We expect aggressive advocacy within the law—not fabricated claims, false identity theft reports, or misuse of consumer protection processes.



## SOFTWARE & WORKFLOW REQUIREMENTS



**LetterStream experience is strongly preferred and will be central to our intended mailing workflow.**



Candidates should have experience with:



- **LetterStream:** dispute letter preparation, mailing, and tracking

- **DisputeFox:** preferred; potential credit repair management platform

- Credit Repair Cloud or comparable dispute management software

- Google Sheets and Google Drive

- Three-bureau credit report review and comparison

- Structured client tracking and case management



You must be able to work within Opulent Credit's selected systems and follow our operational procedures.



## SEAMLESS OPERATIONS, ORGANIZATION & ACCOUNTABILITY



We are building a professional operation that can grow without sacrificing service quality.



**We do not want to micromanage our specialist.**



Every client must have an organized, up-to-date case record containing:



- Initial credit analysis and documented findings

- Individual dispute strategy

- Accounts targeted and factual dispute grounds

- Letters prepared and sent

- Mailing confirmations and tracking information

- Bureau and furnisher responses

- Confirmed deletions and corrections

- Remaining unresolved items

- Follow-up deadlines

- Next-round action plans



### Mandatory Reporting



**WEEKLY REPORTS ARE REQUIRED.**



Weekly reports must include client-by-client progress, actions completed, verified results, unresolved items, upcoming deadlines, and planned next steps.



**DAILY REPORTS MUST BE AVAILABLE WHEN REQUESTED OR OPERATIONALLY NECESSARY.**



Daily reporting may include completed submissions, important correspondence, urgent issues, and time-sensitive follow-ups.



We expect proactive updates, clear communication, and accurate records.



**Management should never have to chase you for basic information about a client's file.**



## PERFORMANCE STANDARDS



Our specialist must demonstrate:



- Proven first-round and second-round dispute results

- Rapid, accurate preparation and submission of legitimate disputes

- Strong analytical and legal knowledge

- Ability to handle both complex and straightforward profiles

- Independent case management

- Consistent deadline tracking and follow-through

- Excellent organization

- Professional written communication

- Confidential handling of client information

- Ability to manage increasing client volume without sacrificing quality



Performance will be evaluated using documented case quality, submission timeliness, compliance, reporting accuracy, client progress, and confirmed dispute outcomes.



**We have a very low tolerance for careless work, missed deadlines, poor communication, inflated results, or unnecessary delays.**



## DOCUMENTED DELETION RESULTS — REQUIRED TO APPLY



**Applicants must provide verifiable, redacted examples of successful credit repair outcomes.**



We want to see:



- Before-and-after credit reports

- Confirmed collection deletions

- Charge-off deletions

- Late-payment corrections or deletions

- Inquiry removals

- First-round and second-round results

- Complex cases with documented outcomes



All sensitive personal information must be removed before submission.



Results must be attributable to work you personally performed.



**Applications without documented outcomes will not advance to the interview stage.**



Claims of experience without evidence are not sufficient.



## COMPANY GROWTH & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Opulent Credit is establishing its backend fulfillment infrastructure in preparation for a major expansion of its marketing and client acquisition efforts.



Our growth strategy includes:



- Aggressive social media marketing

- Lead generation campaigns

- Streamlined client acquisition funnels

- Automated onboarding and client management

- Increasing client volume

- Expansion of our fulfillment team



We're seeking a specialist who can grow with the company, maintain exceptional standards, and potentially advance into greater responsibilities as the operation develops.



Additional client assignments and future leadership opportunities may become available based on business growth and individual performance.



**We're building an elite operation, and everyone involved must be prepared to operate at that standard.**



Our owner is Filipino and has family in the Philippines. We value building strong professional relationships with talented specialists based in the Philippines.



## COMPENSATION STRUCTURE



**Compensation is structured per client, per completed dispute round.**



Opulent Credit will discuss compensation directly with shortlisted candidates during the interview process.



The agreed rate, defined scope of each round, completion criteria, reporting requirements, and payment terms will be established before work begins.



Additional work outside the agreed scope will be addressed separately.



**Applicants are not required to submit their desired salary or rate.**



We are seeking professionals who are confident in their ability to demonstrate results and contribute to a growing operation.



## APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS — READ CAREFULLY



**To be considered, you MUST answer all seven questions below.**



**1. EXPERIENCE:** How many years have you personally worked in credit repair, and how many active client files have you independently managed simultaneously?



**2. PROVEN RESULTS:** Provide redacted before-and-after evidence of successful charge-off, collection, late-payment, or inquiry deletions/corrections. Identify which results were achieved in the first or second round.



**3. FIRST-ROUND STRATEGY:** Explain your approach to reviewing a new client's three-bureau report, identifying legitimate inaccuracies, and preparing an effective first-round dispute strategy.



**4. LEGAL EXPERTISE:** Explain your experience applying the FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, Metro 2 reporting requirements, and appropriately using FTC reports and CFPB complaints.



**5. SOFTWARE:** Describe your experience with LetterStream, DisputeFox, Credit Repair Cloud, and other relevant tools.



**6. ORGANIZATION & REPORTING:** Explain how you maintain client records, track dispute deadlines, document outcomes, and deliver weekly and requested daily progress reports.



**7. AVAILABILITY:** Confirm your availability to begin with a smaller client portfolio and accept additional assignments as our business grows.



**Incomplete applications, generic responses, and applications without documented results will not advance.**
