title: Executive Operations Analyst | CEO Support & Business Reporting
description:
SimulEYE is an established, innovative U.S.-based company headquartered in Southern California. We develop and manufacture specialized surgical training models used by ophthalmic surgeons and leading medical device companies to advance surgical education.



We are a small, entrepreneurial company with an international presence, working with customers and partners across the United States, Europe, and beyond.



Our team values intelligence, initiative, integrity, exceptional attention to detail, and people who take genuine ownership of their work. We believe in building long-term relationships with talented professionals who want to contribute, grow, and make a meaningful difference.



The Opportunity



We are seeking an exceptionally capable Executive Operations Analyst to become a trusted right hand to our CEO and Chief Strategy Officer (CSO).



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role, and it is not an accounting position.



It is a unique combination of high-level executive support, business operations, analytical reporting, financial administration, and problem-solving.



Your primary responsibility will be supporting our CEO (approximately 80%) and CSO (approximately 20%), helping them stay organized, informed, and focused on the highest-value activities.



You will also serve as a central point of coordination across our business, interacting with operations, sales, marketing, accounting, and other team members on behalf of our executive leadership.



You are not being hired to support every department independently. You are being hired to help our executives move important work forward, gather information, create useful reports, coordinate projects, and ensure commitments are fulfilled.



We are looking for someone who thinks, not simply someone who completes tasks.



You should be comfortable receiving an objective, asking intelligent questions, determining what information is needed, and figuring out how to deliver an accurate, useful result.



For example:



Our CSO may ask you to develop a cash-flow forecast to help evaluate upcoming business decisions. You’ll work with the appropriate people, gather the data, build the spreadsheet, and present the information clearly.

Our leadership team may need a consolidated sales report. You’ll coordinate with our sales executives, obtain the information, troubleshoot reporting issues, and develop a useful report.

We may be planning several international medical conferences. You’ll coordinate with sales and marketing, create a tracking system, monitor deadlines, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Our CEO may need help managing a busy inbox, organizing priorities, scheduling appointments, or following up on important commitments.

We will explain our objectives and train you on our business and processes. However, we want someone who naturally takes initiative, thinks critically, anticipates needs, and finds solutions without requiring constant direction.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Executive Support & Organization



Manage and organize the CEO’s
 inbox, prioritize important communications, prepare draft responses, and ensure timely follow-up.

Coordinate executive calendars, meetings, appointments, and business travel.

Arrange flights, hotels, transportation, conferences, and occasional personal appointments.

Track priorities, deadlines, commitments, and action items for the CEO and CSO.

Conduct research, prepare documents, and coordinate special projects.

Anticipate executive needs and proactively identify ways to improve organization and efficiency.

Business Operations & Project Coordination



Coordinate projects and initiatives on behalf of the CEO and CSO, working with our operations, sales, marketing, and accounting teams.

Gather information from different departments and organize it into useful reports and tracking systems.

Monitor project timelines, deliverables, and follow-up to ensure work is completed.

Develop and improve spreadsheets, workflows, tracking tools, and standard operating procedures.

Identify inefficiencies, investigate problems, and recommend practical solutions.

Analytical Reporting & Financial Administration



Build and maintain spreadsheets, management reports, cash-flow forecasts, revenue projections, and sales performance reports.

Compile and analyze financial and operational data from QuickBooks Online, HubSpot, Excel, Google Sheets, and other business systems.

Prepare commission calculations, expense reports, reconciliations, and other recurring reports.

Assist with routine financial administration, including payroll processing, invoicing, bookkeeping coordination, and financial recordkeeping.

Work with our outside accounting professionals as needed to obtain information and support accurate reporting.

Review data for accuracy, identify inconsistencies, and communicate findings clearly to leadership.

You do not need to be a CPA or professional accountant. However, strong financial literacy, excellent numerical skills, and the ability to create sophisticated, accurate spreadsheets and reports are essential.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for an unusually capable professional who combines analytical intelligence with exceptional organization, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to work.



The most important qualities are:



Exceptional analytical and problem-solving ability. You can take an unfamiliar challenge, understand the objective, identify the necessary information, and develop a solution.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. You are highly proficient with formulas, data analysis, reporting, and building useful spreadsheets from scratch.

Strong financial fluency. You understand business financial information, can work confidently with numbers, and are comfortable preparing financial and operational reports.

Outstanding attention to detail. You naturally verify information, catch discrepancies, and take pride in delivering accurate work.

Excellent judgment and initiative. You anticipate needs, ask thoughtful questions, identify opportunities for improvement, and know when to escalate an issue.

Strong executive presence and communication. You have excellent spoken and written English and can communicate professionally with senior executives.

Independence and accountability. You manage priorities, follow through on commitments, and take ownership of results without constant supervision.

Technological adaptability. You learn new software quickly and are comfortable using modern productivity tools, including AI, to work more effectively.

Discretion and professionalism. You can be trusted with confidential business, financial, and personal information.

Preferred Experience



We welcome candidates with backgrounds in:



Executive operations or senior executive support

Business operations or business analysis

Financial or operational reporting

Project coordination or operations management

Process improvement and workflow development

Experience with QuickBooks Online, HubSpot, payroll administration, and executive inbox management is highly desirable.



A bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or a related field is preferred, but demonstrated capability and relevant experience are more important than a specific degree.



We are especially interested in candidates who have personally created reports, developed systems, solved operational problems, or improved business processes - not simply maintained systems created by someone else.



What the Work Environment Is Like



Although this position involves a broad range of responsibilities, it is not an expectation that you will be performing every task simultaneously.



Our current executive support professional successfully manages the established responsibilities on a part-time schedule. We are expanding the position to full-time to provide greater availability, strengthen executive support, and create capacity for additional projects and operational improvements.



You will receive training on our business, systems, and existing processes, with the opportunity to assume greater ownership as you become familiar with the company.



We are a collaborative, professional team that values thoughtful work, accuracy, direct communication, and mutual respect.



Our CEO has high standards for quality, attention to detail, and follow-through. The right candidate will appreciate those standards and take personal pride in meeting them.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career relationship with us and become an important, trusted member of our team.



Schedule & Compensation



Full-time: Approximately 40 hours per week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

Location: Remote, Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor

Compensation: $1,800–$2,200 USD per month, based on experience and demonstrated capabilities

Growth: Compensation and responsibilities will be reviewed after an initial 90-day period, with opportunities for further growth based on performance

Screening: Finalists will complete a practical skills assessment; reference and background checks will be required before engagement



How to Apply



Please use the subject line:



SimulEYE – Think Beyond the Task



To apply, please provide:



1. Your current résumé/CV, including relevant professional experience.

2. A brief introduction (3–5 sentences) explaining why this position interests you and how your background combines analytical reporting, business operations, and executive support.

3. One specific example of a report, spreadsheet, process, or system you personally created or improved. What problem did it solve?

4. A short introductory video (60–90 seconds) so we can learn more about you and your communication style. A simple, informal recording is perfectly fine.



Please confirm your availability to work full-time during U.S. Pacific business hours.



Please apply using at least 5 Apply Points.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical skills exercise and participate in an interview.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



We are looking for an exceptional professional who wants to do more than manage tasks. If you enjoy solving problems, building useful systems, working with numbers, and becoming a trusted partner to executive leadership, we would love to hear from you!

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to join our team in a long-term role.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys staying organized, communicating with customers, managing follow-ups, solving routine problems, and helping daily operations run smoothly.



We are looking for someone who takes responsibility for their work, pays attention to detail, follows through on commitments, and can become increasingly independent over time.



Position Details



- Initial schedule: 25-30 hours per week

- Initial working days: Monday–Saturday, 5 hours per day

- Future schedule: Planned transition to 40 hours per week

- Working hours: Scheduled within the 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time window, Monday through Saturday as applicable

- Starting pay: $3.50 per hour

- Long-term opportunity

- Paid training provided

- Performance-based bonus opportunities

- Opportunity for professional growth and advancement



The role will begin with an initial 25-hour weekly schedule, with the plan to transition to full-time hours as business needs and performance allow.



Responsibilities

- Customer Service & Communication

- Respond to customer inquiries professionally and clearly.

- Handle routine customer calls, texts, and follow-ups.

- Collect and maintain accurate customer information.

- Help customers with routine questions and requests.

- Recognize when an issue needs to be escalated.



Lead Management & Follow-Up

- Respond to new leads in a timely manner.

- Follow up with leads who have not responded.

- Keep lead information organized and updated.

- Track follow-ups so opportunities are not missed.

- Maintain accurate records of lead activity.



Scheduling & Operations Support

- Assist with scheduling and booking coordination.

- Communicate scheduling information to customers.

- Help manage routine scheduling changes according to established procedures.

- Keep operational information accurate and organized.

- Follow up on outstanding scheduling matters.



Administrative & Organizational Tasks

- Perform data entry and maintain organized records.

- Manage daily administrative tasks.

- Track assigned work, deadlines, and follow-ups.

- Use Trello to manage tasks and operational workflows.

- Use Google Workspace and other company systems.

- Follow established procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs).



Daily Accountability & Reporting

- Complete a daily checklist.

- Submit an end-of-day (EOD) report each working day.

- Report completed work, customer and lead activity, outstanding tasks, and issues requiring attention.

- Keep Trello tasks updated.

- Communicate important updates and blockers promptly.



Independent Problem-Solving

- Handle routine responsibilities independently when authorized.

- Review available instructions and SOPs before asking questions.

- Use sound judgment when prioritizing work.

- Ask for guidance or approval when a situation falls outside established procedures.



Requirements



- Good written and spoken English.

- Good communication and customer-service skills.

- Very organized and detail-oriented.

- Reliable, consistent, and responsible.

- Able to follow instructions and established procedures.

- Comfortable learning new software and systems.

- Able to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups.

- Able to work independently while recognizing when to ask for guidance.

- Professional and respectful when communicating with customers and team members.

- Previous virtual assistant, customer service, administrative, or operations experience preferred.



Training will be provided on company systems, workflows, and procedures.



Initial 30-Day Evaluation Period



The first 30 days will be an Initial 30-Day Evaluation Period focused on training, learning the company's systems, and evaluating overall performance.



During this period, we will evaluate:



- Reliability and attendance.

- Communication and professionalism.

- Quality and accuracy of work.

- Ability to follow instructions and SOPs.

- Organization and follow-through.

- Initiative and problem-solving.

- Ability to learn and work increasingly independently.



Continued engagement and future compensation reviews will depend on performance and the needs of the business. Pay & Performance-Based Growth



The starting rate is $3.50 per hour during the initial 30-day evaluation period.



Performance reviews may take place at the following milestones:



| Review Milestone | Potential Hourly Rate |

| Initial 30 days | $3.50 |

| 30-day review | $4.00 |

| 90-day review | $4.25 |

| 6-month review | $4.50 |

| 9-month review | $4.75 |

| 12-month review | $5.00 |



Important: These are potential rates associated with performance-review milestones, not guaranteed pay increases.



Reaching a milestone does not automatically qualify someone for a raise. Increases must be earned through demonstrated reliability, quality of work, communication, organization, follow-through, initiative, adherence to procedures, and the ability to handle responsibilities successfully.



Our philosophy is simple: Time makes you eligible for a review; performance earns the raise.



Performance-based bonus opportunities may also be available.



Career Growth



We want to build a long-term team and provide opportunities for people who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, and increasing responsibility.





Advancement will depend on demonstrated ability, performance, business needs, and readiness for greater responsibility.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A summary of your previous virtual assistant, customer service, administrative, or operations experience.

About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Senior Estimator to join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering business, providing dedicated support to the existing Senior Estimator and Project Management team.



This is a hybrid role, with approximately 70% focused on Estimator Support and 30% on Quality Support.



The primary focus will be assisting the existing Senior Estimator with the preparation of estimates, material take-offs, cutting 

lists, supplier pricing, tender documentation, and other estimating requirements.



The role will also provide quality support across projects, including preparing QA documentation, NDT requests, MDRs, weld maps, and maintaining welding and quality registers.



The ideal candidate will be an experienced steel fabrication estimator who also has practical experience in quality control, welding documentation, project coordination, or fabrication quality processes.



This is not a standalone Senior Estimator position. The successful candidate will work as a hands-on support resource, stepping in to assist with estimating and quality requirements as needed while working closely with the existing team.



Key Responsibilities



Estimator Support – Primary Focus



- Support the existing Senior Estimator with day-to-day estimating activities.

- Review client RFQs, drawings, specifications, and project documentation.

- Interpret design and engineering requirements and identify information requiring clarification.

- Prepare detailed Material Take-Offs (MTOs).

- Prepare material quantities, cutting lists, and other fabrication-related documentation.

- Determine material, machinery, labour, fabrication, and other project requirements.

- Assist with preparing detailed estimates and cost calculations.

- Obtain and compare supplier pricing for materials and fabrication requirements.

- Liaise with suppliers to obtain current and accurate material costs.

- Assist with preparing quotations, proposals, and tender submissions.

- Review estimates for accuracy, scope, quantities, and pricing before submission.

- Assist with quote revisions, variations, and changes to project requirements.

- Support the Senior Estimator with tender deadlines and estimating workload.

- Step in and provide estimating coverage when required.



Technical & Fabrication Support



- Read and interpret engineering, fabrication, structural, and mechanical drawings.

- Review job packs and identify materials and fabrication requirements.

- Understand steel fabrication processes and associated material and labour requirements.

- Assist with identifying suitable fabrication methods and requirements.

- Prepare and maintain fabrication-related documentation, including MTOs and cutting lists.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information, or potential issues within drawings and project documentation.

- Liaise with the estimating, operations, project management, and quality teams to clarify technical requirements.



Quality & Documentation Support – Approximately 30%



- Support the Quality function when required across active projects.

- Analyse job packs and prepare MTOs as required for quality and project documentation.

- Prepare Weld Maps by identifying appropriate weld procedures and marking welds on drawings and weld traceability - documentation.

- Prepare QA Packs for client submission and approval.

- Compile proposed weld procedures, welder qualifications, and supporting reports for project documentation.

- Prepare NDT requests for projects.

- Prepare Welder Qualification Requests where required.

- Follow up with suppliers for material certificates and surface treatment reports.

- Prepare Manufacturer's Data Reports (MDRs).

- Track outstanding MDRs for completed projects and ensure they are submitted on time.

- Maintain accurate records of welder qualifications and welding documentation.

- Maintain the Welder Qualification Register, including weld reports and upcoming requalification requirements.

- Maintain the Weld Procedure Register and update it when new procedures are received.

- Prepare and maintain other project quality documentation as required.

- Assist with Delivery Dockets and related project documentation.



Project & Team Support



- Work closely with the Senior Estimator, Project Managers, Operations, and Quality personnel.

- Provide estimating and quality support across multiple projects as priorities change.

- Participate in daily online communication, meetings, drawing reviews, and project discussions.

- Proactively communicate progress, outstanding information, pricing issues, quality requirements, and potential risks.

- Raise issues early and seek clarification rather than allowing problems to delay estimates or project documentation.

- Assist Project Managers with project documentation, variations, and technical information where required.

- Help ensure a smooth handover from estimating through to project delivery.

- Provide fill-in support for both estimating and quality functions when required.



Essential Requirements



- Minimum 2 years of experience in Australian steel fabrication or engineering estimating.

- Strong understanding of steel fabrication estimating, including materials, labour, machinery, and fabrication requirements.

- Demonstrated experience preparing MTOs, estimates, quotations, or tender submissions.

- Ability to read and interpret engineering, structural, mechanical, and fabrication drawings.

- Experience working with steel fabrication projects, including structural steel, piping, specialised welding, or related fabrication.

- Strong understanding of welding and fabrication processes.

- Experience with quality documentation, quality control, or project documentation.

- Ability to create or understand Weld Maps and weld traceability documentation.

- Familiarity with NDT requests, QA Packs, MDRs, welder qualifications, and welding registers.

- Understanding of traceability, tracing, and document storage requirements.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience with estimating or digital take-off software.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

- Proactive approach to communication, problem-solving, and teamwork.

- Comfortable working remotely and collaborating daily with an Australian team.



Highly Desirable



- Previous experience working for an Australian steel fabrication or engineering business.

- Experience across both estimating and quality control/quality assurance functions.

- Previous experience supporting Project Managers or Operations teams.

- Experience with structural steel, piping, specialised welding, or industrial fabrication.

- Experience preparing QA Packs and MDRs for Australian projects.

- Experience with NDT coordination and welding documentation.

- Experience maintaining welder qualification and weld procedure registers.

- Understanding of Carbon Steel welding, with exposure to Stainless Steel, Duplex Steel, Wear Plate, or other specialised steels.

- Engineering Degree, Steel Trade qualification, or relevant technical qualification.

- Experience with Bluebeam, CostX, Cubit, PlanSwift, or similar estimating and take-off software.



What Success Looks Like



- The successful candidate will become a reliable second layer of support for the existing estimating and project team.



Success means:



- Providing accurate and timely estimating support.

- Keeping MTOs, cutting lists, supplier pricing, and tender documentation organised and up to date.

- Helping the Senior Estimator manage estimating workload and deadlines.

- Providing dependable quality support when required.

- Ensuring QA Packs, MDRs, NDT requests, Weld Maps, and registers are completed accurately and on time.

- Identifying issues early and communicating proactively with the team.

- Being able to move comfortably between estimating, project coordination, and quality documentation as business priorities require.



The Opportunity



- Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

- Work Australian business hours.

- Join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering team.

- Work directly alongside an experienced Senior Estimator and Project Managers.

- Approximately 70% Estimator Support / 30% Quality Support.

- Opportunity to develop across estimating, project coordination, and quality functions.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR) / Sales Executive
description:
About the Role



We are a growing digital marketing and web development agency looking for a motivated Business Development Representative / Sales Executive to help us acquire new clients.



This is not just an appointment-setting position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the full sales process, from finding qualified prospects to communicating with decision-makers and ultimately closing deals.

, cold calling, social media, directories, and other outreach channels.

* Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers.

* Understand each prospect’s business, challenges, and potential needs.

* Qualify leads and identify genuine sales opportunities.

* Schedule and conduct sales calls and discovery meetings.

* Present our services and explain how we can help the prospect’s business.

* Prepare or coordinate proposals and pricing.

* Handle common sales objections and negotiations.

* Close new clients and bring in new revenue.

* Maintain accurate lead, conversation, follow-up, and deal information in our CRM.

* Provide regular reporting on outreach activity, meetings, pipeline, and closed deals.



Services You’ll Be Selling



Our agency provides services including:



* Website Design & Development

* SEO

* AEO / AI Search Visibility

* Google Ads / PPC

* Meta Ads

* Social Media Marketing

* Branding & Graphic Design

* Website Maintenance & Hosting

* Other digital marketing solutions



Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has previous B2B sales, BDR, SDR, or business development experience.

* Has experience generating their own leads, not only working with leads provided by a company.

* Is comfortable with cold
, LinkedIn outreach, and cold calling.

* Has strong spoken and written English.

* Is confident speaking with U.S.-based business owners and decision-makers.

* Understands how to qualify prospects instead of simply booking as many meetings as possible.

* Has experience conducting sales calls and closing deals.

* Is persistent with follow-ups without being overly aggressive.

* Is organized and comfortable using a CRM.

* Can work independently and is accountable for results.

* Experience selling digital marketing, SEO, web development, advertising, SaaS, or other B2B services is strongly preferred.



How Success Will Be Measured



This is a performance-focused sales position. Key metrics will include:



* Qualified prospects generated

* Outreach and conversations

* Qualified meetings booked

* Proposals sent

* Follow-up activity

* Deals closed

* New monthly revenue generated



Schedule



This is a remote position. Candidates must be available during agreed-upon U.S. business hours for prospecting, calls, meetings, and follow-ups.



Compensation



Base salary + performance-based commission.



Strong performers will have the opportunity to earn significantly more through commissions as they bring new clients to the agency.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your previous B2B sales experience.

2. What types of services or products you’ve sold.

3. Your experience with cold calling,
, and LinkedIn outreach.

4. Whether you’ve personally closed deals or primarily booked appointments.

5. Your experience selling to U.S. businesses.

6. CRM and sales tools you’ve used.

7. Your expected monthly base salary.

8. A short voice or video introduction so we can evaluate communication skills.



Important: We’re looking for someone who can generate opportunities and close business, not someone who only builds lead lists.

title: HIRING: Experienced Faceless YouTube Video Creator / Editor / Voice-Over Artist (Sports Channel)
description:
Long-Term Opportunity | 3 Videos Per Week | $240/Month | Growth Potential



We are looking for a highly experienced and reliable Faceless YouTube Video Creator to join our team and take full responsibility for producing high-quality videos for an already monetized sports YouTube channel.



Our channel currently uses AI-generated videos, but we are looking to transition to human-produced content while maintaining or improving our current production quality.



We are NOT looking for beginners. We want someone who understands how successful faceless YouTube channels operate and has proven experience working with monetized channels.



Your Responsibilities



We want to keep the process as simple as possible.



We provide the script. You handle EVERYTHING else.



This includes:



Turning our scripts into engaging, professional YouTube videos.



Recording your own natural, human voice-over.



Editing videos with professional pacing, transitions, sound effects and engaging visuals.



Finding and selecting relevant sports footage and visuals that can legally be used in monetized YouTube videos.



Creating high-quality, clickable YouTube thumbnails.



Uploading finished videos directly to YouTube.



Making sure each video is ready for publication.



Maintaining consistent quality across all uploads.



Ensuring that all content complies with YouTube's copyright and monetization policies.



STRICT Requirements — Please Read Carefully



1. Proven Experience With Monetized YouTube Channels



You MUST have previously worked on at least 1 monetized YouTube channel, preferably in the sports niche.



You must be able to provide proof of your experience, such as links to channels, published videos, or verifiable examples of your work.



2. Natural English Voice-Over



You MUST be able to record your own voice-overs.



We are specifically looking for someone who sounds natural to an American or British audience, with a convincing American or British English accent.



We do NOT want robotic, AI-generated, or heavily synthetic-sounding voice-overs.



Previous voice-over experience is strongly preferred.



3. Professional Video Editing Skills



You must know how to create engaging faceless YouTube videos that keep viewers watching.



This includes:



Strong storytelling and visual pacing.



Smooth transitions and professional editing.



Good use of sports footage, graphics, and sound effects.



Understanding audience retention and watch time.



Maintaining the same quality as our existing videos, or improving it.



4. YouTube Thumbnail Experience



You must understand how to create thumbnails that attract attention and encourage viewers to click.



Experience with click-through rate (CTR), thumbnail design, and YouTube performance optimization is essential.



5. Understanding of YouTube Monetization & Copyright



You must understand YouTube's monetization requirements, copyright considerations, and how to create original, high-quality content suitable for monetized channels.



Since this is a sports channel, knowing how to source footage that can legally be used commercially is extremely important.



You must understand the risks of copyright claims and strikes, and know how to minimize those risks by using properly licensed or otherwise authorized content.



Workload & Payment



Niche: Sports



Video length: 15–25 minutes



Frequency: 3 videos per week



Monthly workload: 12 videos



Monthly payment: $240 ($20 per video)



Collaboration: Long-term



We understand that this is a starting budget.



However, we are looking for someone who wants to grow together with the channel.



As the channel achieves stronger results and generates more revenue, we intend to increase compensation accordingly.



Our goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who takes ownership of the content and genuinely understands YouTube growth.



How to Apply



To be considered, you MUST provide the following:



1. Proof of Experience



Links to monetized YouTube channels you have worked on, including an explanation of your role and evidence of monetization.



2. Video Examples



At least 2–3 examples of faceless YouTube videos you personally edited or produced.



3. Voice-Over Sample



A recording of your own voice speaking English naturally, preferably from previous YouTube work.



4. Thumbnail Examples



At least 3 thumbnails you personally created.



5. Your Experience



Explain how long you have been working with faceless YouTube channels and what results you have achieved.



6. Your Answer to This Important Question



"How do you source copyright-free or properly licensed sports footage for YouTube videos, and how do you ensure that the footage can be used commercially without risking copyright claims, strikes, or demonetization? Please explain your process and provide examples from your previous experience."



We expect a detailed and practical answer based on real experience, not a generic response.



IMPORTANT — PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



You have never worked on a monetized YouTube channel.



You cannot provide proof of your previous work.



You cannot record your own natural English voice-over.



You have no experience creating professional faceless YouTube videos.



You do not know how to create effective YouTube thumbnails.



You do not understand how to source legally usable sports footage.



You cannot handle the full production process independently.



You are not comfortable with the stated starting budget.



We are not willing to compromise on experience or quality.



We are looking for a serious, skilled professional who can help us take an already monetized sports channel to the next level.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person. As the channel grows, your compensation can grow with it.



Which monetized YouTube channel(s) have you previously worked on?



Please provide the channel name(s) and direct YouTube links, explain your exact role, and provide proof that the channel(s) were monetized during your involvement.



Applications without this information will not be considered.





If you meet ALL the requirements and are interested in building something long-term, we would love to hear from you.

description:
RELIABLE REVENUE ASSISTANT

Virtual Assistant: Insurance, Accounts Receivable & Practice Systems

Ocean Park Optometry | Santa Monica, California | Full Time, Long Term, Remote





ABOUT OCEAN PARK OPTOMETRY



Ocean Park Optometry is a busy, patient focused optometry practice in Santa Monica, California, where our promise is simple: See Better, Live Brighter. We provide advanced, personalized eye care including dry eye treatment, myopia management, scleral lenses, concierge eye care, and luxury eyewear.



We are building a cohesive, high functioning, elite team of eye care professionals to scale our business by providing outstanding customer service, products, and services. Every member of our team is professional in demeanor, speech, appearance, and actions, and that standard applies equally to our remote team.





THE ROLE



We are seeking a highly dependable, detail oriented Virtual Assistant to own our back office: insurance billing, accounts receivable, reconciliation, prior authorizations, documents, and contact lens order tracking. You will also serve as the backup person for our phone, text, and
 communications.



This role is more than task completion. You will be the guardian of our processes. You will verify that our systems are being followed, catch issues before they become problems, and proactively stop things from falling through the cracks. You will track key performance indicators (KPIs) that drive constant improvement in our processes, our business growth, and the quality of every patient's experience.



This is a long term, full time position for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and enjoys being an essential part of a collaborative team.





SCHEDULE



You must be available to work our California business hours:



- Tuesday through Friday, 8:25 AM to 5:30 PM Pacific Time

- Saturday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time



Please apply only if you can reliably work these hours and have stable high speed internet, a dependable computer with dual monitors, and a quiet professional workspace. Backup internet and power are expected.





PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Insurance and Accounts Receivable

- Create and submit insurance claims accurately and on time

- Review insurance claims, payments, denials, and outstanding balances

- Post and reconcile insurance payments accurately

- Follow up on unpaid, denied, underpaid, or delayed insurance claims

- Maintain organized insurance billing and accounts receivable tracking spreadsheets

- Research claim discrepancies and prepare clear notes for the office team



Prior Authorizations, Benefits, and Documents

- Prepare and submit prior authorizations and track them through approval

- Verify insurance benefits and eligibility ahead of patient visits

- Prepare receipts, letters, forms, and other patient or office documents as assigned



Contact Lens Orders

- Place and track contact lens orders, status, invoices, and patient communication needs



Process Verification and Quality Control

- Verify that office processes are being followed consistently and completely

- Identify gaps, delays, and missing information proactively, before they affect patients or revenue

- Recommend and help implement process improvements



KPIs and Reporting

- Track and report KPIs such as days in accounts receivable, clean claim rate, denial rate, collections by aging bucket (30, 60, 90+ days), prior authorization turnaround, and contact lens order turnaround

- Maintain accurate spreadsheets, reports, logs, and administrative records

- Use data to highlight trends and opportunities for growth and a better patient experience



Communication

- Serve as the backup person for patient and office phone calls, texts, and
s, responding with warmth, polish, and professionalism

- Communicate proactively with the Practice Manager and team regarding urgent items, missing information, and next steps

- Assist with other administrative projects as needed





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You must have excellent written and spoken English that sounds natural, polished, and professional to patients and United States based team members. You should be comfortable making and answering phone calls, and responding to patient texts and
s, and you will present yourself professionally on video meetings.



The right person is:



- Highly organized and exceptionally detail oriented

- Experienced with medical insurance billing, claims submission and follow up, payment posting, or reconciliation

- Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and able to keep records accurate and easy to review

- Proactive and anticipatory, able to identify an issue and suggest the next step without waiting to be told

- Systems minded, someone who notices when a process is not being followed and takes action

- Comfortable tracking metrics and using numbers to drive improvement

- Flexible and comfortable shifting priorities in a fast paced office

- Outgoing, warm, professional, and able to work well with different personalities

- Trustworthy, discreet, and respectful of confidential patient and financial information

- Reliable, responsive, and accountable for completing assignments on time

- Willing to learn optometry specific processes, including contact lens orders and vision insurance procedures



Experience with United States medical billing, vision insurance, optometry, ophthalmology, or dental insurance is strongly preferred. Experience with OfficeMate, ExamWriter, VSP, EyeMed, Medicare, Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, or Anthem is a plus, but not required.





TO APPLY



Please submit all of the following to 



1. A brief introduction explaining your relevant insurance billing or reconciliation experience

2. Your resume

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself in English

4. Confirm that the $5 hourly wage is acceptable

5. Your internet speed test results

6. A brief description of your insurance experience

7. One KPI you have tracked in a previous role and how it helped improve results



Include the words "Reliable Revenue Assistant" in the subject line of your application so we know you read the full posting.



Applications sent through the OnlineJobs.ph message system alone, without the items above, will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long term role and takes pride in making an office run better every day. We look forward to working with you!

title: Experienced YouTube Video Editor | Long Form + Shorts
description:
Experienced YouTube Video Editor | Long Form + Shorts



Part Time | Remote | $6 USD per Hour | 10 Hours per Week



Initial commitment: 10 hours per week

Growth potential: Additional hours may become available as our production volume and business grow



ABOUT YEARS YOUNGER



Years Younger is a movement, mobility, strength, and performance longevity brand helping active adults stay strong, mobile, capable, confident, and adventurous.



We're actively growing our YouTube channel and looking for a skilled, experienced video editor with excellent creative judgment who can turn educational, talking-head, and movement-based footage into polished, engaging, professional videos.



This is primarily a video editing position, not a social media management or virtual assistant role.



I'm not looking for someone who simply knows how to cut clips together. I'm looking for an editor who understands visual storytelling, pacing, viewer retention, B-roll, music, dynamic text, motion graphics, and, equally important, when to keep editing simple.



Our audience appreciates expertise, sophistication, and authenticity. Our videos should reflect those qualities while being visually compelling and enjoyable to watch.





WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



You'll work on a variety of content, including:



* Long-form YouTube videos, including educational and talking-head content.

* Movement, mobility, strength, Pilates, GYROTONIC®, GYROKINESIS®, Qigong, and breathwork videos.

* YouTube Shorts and vertical social videos.

* Strong opening sequences and attention-grabbing hooks.

* B-roll sequences that visually reinforce what the speaker is teaching.

* Dynamic on-screen text, captions, motion graphics, and visual elements.

* Music and sound design that enhance the production without overpowering the content.

* Repurposing longer videos into polished, engaging short-form content.



Our goal is to create videos that hold attention, communicate valuable information clearly, and feel professional from beginning to end.





OUR EDITING STANDARDS



We're looking for an editor with strong technical skills and excellent visual judgment.



You should be able to demonstrate:



* Pacing and viewer retention: Create compelling openings, maintain visual interest, remove unnecessary pauses and repetition, and keep longer videos flowing naturally.

* Sophisticated text and graphics: Use attractive typography, animated text, motion graphics, and visual emphasis where appropriate. Text should feel intentional and dynamic, not static, overly simple, or repetitive.

* Excellent B-roll selection: Choose visuals that support the actual teaching, match the spoken content, and enhance understanding.

* Professional audio: Maintain clear dialogue, consistent volume, balanced music, and clean transitions between clips.

* Movement accuracy: Preserve exercise continuity and ensure that the demonstrated movement matches the instruction. Accurate synchronization of spoken words and visible movements is essential.

* Creative judgment: Know when to add visual energy and when to allow movement, instruction, and the speaker's personality to carry the video.

* Polished finishing: Deliver clean cuts, accurate captions, appropriate transitions, professional cropping, and consistent visual presentation.



Preserve the authentic appearance of the instructor, including facial features, body proportions, and movement accuracy. Do not use AI-generated facial alterations, body modifications, or beauty filters without prior approval.



We do not want videos overloaded with unnecessary effects, distracting graphics, random B-roll, or excessive stock footage.



At the same time, simply cutting footage together without thoughtful editing is not sufficient.



We're looking for an editor who can make a video more compelling without making it unnecessarily busy.





QUALITY CONTROL IS PART OF THE JOB



Before submitting a finished video, you are responsible for reviewing your own work carefully.



This includes checking:



* Audio levels and dialogue synchronization.

* Spelling, captions, graphics, and text placement.

* B-roll relevance and timing.

* Pacing, transitions, and awkward cuts.

* Movement continuity and visual accuracy.

* Cropping, framing, and export quality.

* The complete video from beginning to end.



All music, B-roll, stock footage, and graphics must be appropriately licensed or approved for commercial use. You must be able to identify the source of any third-party assets included in your edits.



Our expectation is to receive polished, publish-ready videos, not rough edits that require extensive corrections.



We welcome creative ideas, thoughtful recommendations, and an editor who takes pride in the finished product.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Qualifications and experience:



* At least 4 years of professional video editing experience preferred.

* A strong portfolio demonstrating complete long-form YouTube editing.

* Excellent short-form editing skills for YouTube Shorts and Reels.

* Experience with educational, talking-head, coaching, fitness, wellness, podcast, or personal-brand content.

* Strong B-roll selection, motion text, audio mixing, and creative pacing skills.

* An understanding of YouTube viewer retention and the importance of the first 30 seconds.

* Excellent attention to detail and professional quality control.

* Strong English comprehension and communication.

* Ability to follow established brand guidelines while contributing original creative ideas.

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

* Willingness to receive feedback, make accurate revisions, and meet agreed deadlines.

* Reliable communication and realistic time estimates.



We particularly value editors who can recognize opportunities to improve a video without needing detailed instructions for every cut, transition, or graphic.





EDITING SOFTWARE



You should be highly proficient in at least one professional video editing platform:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut



Experience with After Effects or professional motion graphics is a plus.



Descript experience is helpful but not required. We can train a strong editor on the portions of Descript used in our workflow.



You do not need to know every editing program. Your demonstrated editing ability, creative judgment, and quality of finished work are more important than the number of programs you know.





SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



This is a remote, ongoing, part-time position.



Starting pay: $6 USD per hour.



Expected workload: Approximately 10 hours per week, with the potential to increase to 12 hours as our production needs and working relationship develop.



Hours and project priorities will be agreed upon in advance.



You do not need to work entirely during U.S. business hours, but you must have reliable communication overlap during Pacific Time working hours.



My normal working day is approximately 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, Los Angeles.



We value organized, efficient work and an editor who can deliver high-quality results within realistic, agreed-upon timeframes.





COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



Reliable, timely communication is essential and will be evaluated during both the hiring process and paid editing test.



During your agreed working hours, you are expected to acknowledge direct work messages within two hours.



This includes questions, file access issues, revision requests, project updates, and deadline-related communication.



You do not need to have a complete answer within two hours. A brief acknowledgment is sufficient, along with an estimated time for a more detailed response if necessary.



Messages received outside your scheduled working hours can be acknowledged at the beginning of your next scheduled work period.



If you encounter a problem that could affect an agreed deadline, you're expected to communicate it as soon as you become aware of it.



We also expect proactive progress updates on longer assignments rather than having to repeatedly ask about project status.



We're looking for someone who communicates professionally, takes responsibility for their work, and follows through on commitments.





PROJECT FILES AND DELIVERY



All production materials, completed video files, and approved final deliverables must be organized within our company-controlled Google Drive production system.



Editors must be willing and able to provide:



* Final exported videos in the agreed format and resolution.

* Editable project files and associated assets needed for continued editing or future revisions.

* Organized files and clear naming conventions.



Before beginning an assignment, you must confirm that your editing software supports a project handoff method that allows Years Younger to access and continue editing the work.



Projects must not remain accessible only through your personal editing account.



We want to establish a professional, organized production workflow where completed projects remain accessible to Years Younger.





PAID EDITING TEST



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test before a final hiring decision.



This is an actual Years Younger production assignment, not a hypothetical editing exercise.



Because we're actively publishing content, the goal is to create a polished, professional, publish-ready video.



Each test will include:



* Actual source footage and a clear editing brief.

* An agreed scope, authorized number of hours, payment, and deadline.

* An initial creative checkpoint to review the editing direction before the complete assignment is finished.

* Clear deliverable and project handoff requirements.



We'll evaluate creative judgment, editing quality, pacing, visual storytelling, audio, accuracy, communication, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver a finished video that meets our standards.



A professional portfolio is essential, but the ability to produce excellent work independently is what ultimately matters.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph messages only.



Please do not
 the address associated with this account. Shortlisted applicants will receive instructions for the next step.



Use "Years Younger Video Editor" as your application subject line.



Please answer the following questions.





1. VIDEO PORTFOLIO, DIRECT GOOGLE DRIVE LINKS REQUIRED



Provide links to:



* Two complete long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.

* Two strong short-form videos, such as YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels, that you personally edited.



IMPORTANT: DIRECT GOOGLE DRIVE VIDEO LINKS ARE REQUIRED.



Please provide direct Google Drive links to the actual video files.



Do not submit a Canva website or Canva portfolio as a substitute for these links.



Canva portfolio websites and embedded video previews frequently fail to load correctly or do not allow me to review the entire video.



You may include your Canva portfolio as additional information, but I still require direct Google Drive links to all four video examples.



Before submitting your application, please verify that:



* Each Google Drive link opens directly to the actual video file.

* Sharing permissions are set to "Anyone with the link can view."

* Each video loads and plays correctly from beginning to end.

* Your two long-form examples are complete videos, not shortened previews, demo reels, or highlight compilations.

* Your video links do not require access approval or special permissions.



Applications without accessible, direct Google Drive video links may not be reviewed.





2. YOUR PERSONAL CONTRIBUTION



For each of the four video examples, briefly explain exactly what you personally handled.



For example, did you perform the complete edit, initial cuts, B-roll selection, graphics, animation, color correction, audio mixing, captions, or final finishing?





3. CREATIVE JUDGMENT



Choose one of your long-form video examples and identify one specific timestamp where you made an editing decision you're particularly proud of.



Tell me what you did at that moment and why you made that choice.



I'm interested in understanding how you think as an editor, not simply which software you know.





4. EXPERIENCE AND SOFTWARE



How many years have you worked professionally as a video editor?



Which editing programs do you currently use, and which one is your primary editing platform?





5. EDITORIAL APPROACH



Briefly explain how you approach B-roll selection, pacing, motion text, music, graphics, and transitions in an educational talking-head YouTube video.



How do you make the content more interesting and improve viewer retention without distracting from the speaker?





6. AVAILABILITY AND COMPENSATION



Please confirm:



* That $6 USD per hour works for you.

* That approximately 10 hours per week works for you.

* Your normal working days and hours, shown in Pacific Time.

* That you can spread 10 hours over 3 days each week  4 hours on Day 1, 4 hours on Day 2, and 2 hours on Day 3 for revisions, final quality control, and delivery

* Your availability for communication between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM Pacific Time.

* Any other jobs or regular client commitments that affect your availability.

* Your earliest available start date.





7. QUALITY CONTROL



Briefly explain the steps you take to check a completed video for errors before submitting it to a client.





8. ATTENTION TO DETAIL



Somewhere in your response about your editorial approach, naturally include the word spine.



Please use it in a complete, relevant sentence rather than adding it separately.



This helps us identify applicants who have read the instructions carefully.





FINAL NOTE



We're looking for someone interested in developing a long-term working relationship and contributing to the growth of Years Younger.



This is an opportunity for an editor who enjoys thoughtful, creative work, cares about quality, communicates professionally, and takes genuine pride in creating videos that people want to watch.



Concise, specific applications are welcome. Please check all your Google Drive video links before submitting.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a brief, two-minute introduction video explaining their editing experience and walking through one creative decision from their portfolio.



Finalists will then be considered for a paid production test with an agreed scope, compensation, and deadline.



Thank you,



Kerri



Founder, Years Younger

title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:
About Grizzly Mine

Grizzly Mine is a pre-launch apparel and lifestyle brand inspired by the mining towns, industries, and visual language of 1860s California. We are building a contemporary brand with a distinct world around it - one that feels grounded in the period while remaining relevant, wearable, and alive today.  The physical pieces surrounding the product matter to that experience. A hang tag, booklet, sticker, label, or package insert should not feel like generic marketing collateral with an old-fashioned font added to it.



The Opportunity

We are looking for a freelance graphic designer with strong traditional design fundamentals, real print experience, and the creative sensibility to help us develop this side of the Grizzly Mine visual language. This is not primarily a digital or social-media design role. The immediate work is physical, printed material that accompanies our apparel and helps extend the brand beyond the garment itself.



We expect the best work to come through collaboration. Our team will develop the concept and provide a design brief, references, copy, brand materials, and direction. The designer will interpret that material, develop a thoughtful visual solution, and work with us through feedback and refinement until the piece is ready for production.



First Projects

We have two initial projects in mind, completed in sequence:

• Hang Tag - The first assignment. A two-sided printed hang tag for Grizzly Mine T-shirts and hoodies. This smaller project will allow both sides to establish a working rhythm and determine whether the creative fit is right.

• Package Insert Booklet - If the first project goes well, the next assignment will be a small multi-page booklet included with customer shipments. It will introduce customers to the Grizzly Mine world and is expected to incorporate or hold a branded sticker.



These are intended to be the beginning, not the end. We expect an ongoing need for printed brand pieces, packaging-related design, and other graphic design projects as Grizzly Mine develops.



What We Are Looking For

• Strong graphic design fundamentals: typography, composition, hierarchy, color, and visual storytelling.

• Demonstrated experience designing for print, not only digital channels.

• Strong working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and/or Adobe InDesign. Photoshop capability is also useful.

• Understanding of production-ready print files, CMYK and spot-color workflows, bleeds, trim, resolution, and working with printer specifications.

• Ability to use texture, material cues, typography, and composition with restraint rather than relying on effects for their own sake.

• A portfolio showing thoughtful identity, editorial, packaging, print collateral, labels, tags, or other physical design work.

• Comfort receiving a detailed creative brief, asking good questions, presenting ideas, and refining work through multiple rounds of feedback.

• An interest in storytelling and world-building. Historical or heritage-inspired work is a plus, but the ability to interpret a concept creatively is more important than having worked in this exact aesthetic before.



The Creative Standard

The challenge is balance. Grizzly Mine draws from an 1860s Northern California mining-town world, but we are not creating museum reproductions, archaeological artifacts, or novelty Old West graphics. The work should feel as though it belongs naturally within the brand world while still functioning beautifully for a modern customer and modern production.

We value designers who can explore more than one meaningful direction when a concept is still being defined. We are looking for someone who can contribute ideas, not simply execute instructions mechanically.



How We Work

• Our team develops the concept, objectives, content, references, and design brief.

• The designer reviews the brief, asks questions, and develops an initial direction or directions.

• We review together and provide consolidated feedback.

• The designer refines the selected direction through approval and prepares final production-ready files.

• When the relationship works well, we prefer to continue with the same designer so the visual language becomes stronger and more consistent over time.



Who This Will Fit

This project will fit a designer who enjoys doing more than making a layout attractive. You should enjoy thinking about why an object exists, how it feels in someone's hand, what story it communicates, and how the details contribute to a larger brand experience. You should also be comfortable with a collaborative process in which some answers are discovered through the work rather than predetermined before the project begins.

- Starting pay: **$3.00–$4.00 USD per hour**

- Paid training

- Full-time opportunity

- Performance bonuses available

- Pay increases available based on performance

- Opportunity to advance into Lead Management or Acquisitions



We reward people who consistently perform.



Someone who starts at $3–$4/hour can earn increases as they demonstrate reliability, communication skills, lead quality, and production. Can go up to $5 + performance bonuses



## What You Will Do



You will receive training, scripts, rebuttals, and coaching.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Making outbound calls to property owners

- Introducing yourself and the company

- Asking whether they would consider selling their property

- Having natural conversations instead of simply reading a script

- Asking questions about the property

- Learning the property's condition

- Understanding why the owner may want to sell

- Determining their desired selling timeline

- Asking what price they would consider

- Handling basic objections

- Identifying potential motivated sellers

- Scheduling callbacks

- Passing qualified opportunities to our acquisitions team

- Entering accurate notes into our CRM

- Following up when assigned

- Meeting daily activity goals



## You May Be a Good Fit If You Have Experience In



Real estate experience is helpful but NOT required.



We are interested in applicants with experience in:



- Cold calling

- Appointment setting

- Call centers

- Outbound sales

- Customer service

- Mortgage

- Telecommunications

- Collections

- Lead generation



Even if you have never worked in real estate, we can teach you the real-estate side.



## What Matters Most



We are looking for someone who:



- Speaks clear conversational English

- Is easy to understand

- Has a friendly personality

- Is comfortable talking to strangers

- LISTENS after asking questions

- Doesn't constantly interrupt people

- Doesn't sound like they are reading a script

- Can think during a conversation

- Can ask follow-up questions

- Is comfortable hearing "no"

- Remains professional when someone is rude

- Has strong attendance

- Is coachable

- Wants to improve

- Can follow instructions

- Wants stable long-term employment



We prefer someone who is **warm, confident and conversational** rather than overly aggressive.



## Training



We provide training on:



- U.S. real estate terminology

- Motivated sellers

- Property-condition questions

- Seller motivation

- Asking about price

- Seller timelines

- Building rapport

- Objection handling

- Appointment setting

- CRM usage

- Call structure

- Lead qualification



Your calls will be reviewed periodically so we can help you improve.



## Schedule



This is a remote position working U.S. business hours.



You must be available to work during **Eastern Time hours**.



Consistent attendance is extremely important.



## Technical Requirements



You must have:



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Computer/laptop

- Good-quality headset

- Quiet working environment

- Stable electricity

- Ability to use web-based software

- Backup internet preferred



## Growth Opportunity



We prefer promoting from within.



High-performing callers may eventually move into:



**Cold Caller  → Senior Cold Caller → Lead Manager → Junior Acquisitions → Acquisitions**



Employees who produce strong results may also qualify for additional bonuses and pay increases.



## How to Apply



Send the following:



1. Full name

2. Location

3. Current hourly rate expectation

4. Previous work experience

5. Cold-calling or call-center experience, if any

6. Your available working hours

7. Internet speed

8. A **60–90 second voice recording**



For your recording, answer:



**"Imagine you called a homeowner and they said, 'I'm not interested.' What would you say next?"**



Do NOT submit a heavily edited or AI-generated recording. We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



Selected applicants will complete a short interview and mock cold call before being hired.



We are looking for reliable people interested in a **long-term position**, not short-term freelance work.



All calling must follow company procedures and applicable telemarketing, consent, and do-not-call requirements.

Platinum Concrete Coatings is an established U.S. specialty contractor seeking an experienced accountant to take ownership of our accrual-based bookkeeping and provide financial insight to the owner.



We need someone who can maintain accurate books, understand our costs, evaluate pricing, and recommend improvements.



Schedule and Compensation:

Approximately 10–15 hours per week initially, adjusted based on actual workload.

Regular availability to meet during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability.

 Include your requested hourly rate.

Ongoing role.



Responsibilities

Accrual bookkeeping and monthly close: Maintain accurate books in QuickBooks Online, complete reconciliations, and produce reliable financial statements.

Accounts payable and receivable: Track bills, invoices, customer deposits, payments, and outstanding balances.

Journal entries: Prepare and post payroll, accrual, prepaid expense, and correcting entries.

Payroll and cost allocation: Allocate wages, payroll taxes, benefits, materials, and other costs to the correct accounts, Classes, and jobs.

Cost accounting: Align revenue with related costs and report profitability by service and job.

CRM and payment reconciliation: Reconcile CRM invoices and customer payments with QuickBooks, payment processor payouts, and bank deposits.

Customer deposits and revenue: Properly account for deposits held as liabilities, earned revenue, final invoices, processing fees, refunds, and chargebacks.

Accounting troubleshooting: Identify and resolve duplicate transactions, incorrect mappings, missing payments, and integration discrepancies.

Excel and Google Sheets: Build and maintain worksheets for allocations, reconciliation, reporting, and analysis.

Pricing and profitability: Analyze costs, margins, overhead, and break-even pricing. Evaluate how discounts, promotions, and pricing changes affect profit.

Budgeting and forecasting: Support budgets, cash-flow forecasts, and actual-versus-budget reviews.

Owner support: Explain financial results clearly, flag concerns proactively, and recommend practical actions.



Required Experience and Skills

Proven experience managing accrual-based books and monthly close for U.S. businesses.

Strong QuickBooks Online experience, including journal entries, Classes, Locations, and financial reporting.

Contractor or comparable project-based cost accounting experience.

Hands-on CRM experience involving estimates, invoices, deposits, payments, and accounting integrations.

Payroll accounting experience, including reviewing reports, reconciling liabilities, and allocating payroll costs.

Willingness and ability to learn Paylocity, our payroll platform. Prior Paylocity experience is not required.

Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including formulas, SUMIFS, lookup functions, pivot tables, and data reconciliation.

Demonstrated ability to analyze costs, pricing, margins, and profitability.

Clear written and spoken English.

Accuracy, confidentiality, reliable follow-through, and sound judgment.

CPA or comparable accounting qualification preferred. Demonstrated ability and relevant experience matter more than credentials alone.



How to Apply

Your résumé and requested hourly rate.

Your weekly availability and availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

A brief description of your U.S. accrual accounting and cost accounting experience.

The CRM and payroll systems you have used.

One example of an accounting problem you identified and resolved.

One example of how your analysis helped a business improve pricing or profitability.



Shortlisted candidates will participate in a practical financial review and discussion to demonstrate their accounting knowledge, reasoning, and ability to explain recommendations. Professional references will be requested.

title: Market Research Analyst – Australian Commercial Cleaning Industry
description:
# Job Title: Market Research Analyst – Australian Commercial Cleaning Industry



**Job Type:** Part-Time / Freelance / Project-Based  

**Location:** Remote  

**Target Market:** Australia – All States and Territories  

**Industry:** Commercial Cleaning and Cleaning Services



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Market Research Analyst to conduct comprehensive market research for a new cleaning business we are planning to establish in Australia.



The goal is to understand the Australian cleaning industry, identify profitable business opportunities, analyse competitors, research market pricing, and develop a clear picture of how to enter and grow in this industry.



We need someone who can conduct detailed research, verify information, contact businesses when necessary, and present findings in a professional report that will help us make informed business decisions.



This is not just a data collection role. We need someone who can analyse the market and provide practical business recommendations.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Australian Cleaning Industry Research

- Research the commercial cleaning industry across Australia.

- Analyse demand for cleaning services in different states, cities, and regions.

- Identify the most promising customer segments and service categories.

- Research industry trends, growth opportunities, and potential challenges.



### 2. Competitor Analysis

- Identify established cleaning companies, smaller operators, and franchises.

- Research their services, target customers, geographical coverage, and business models.

- Analyse their marketing strategies, strengths, and weaknesses.

- Identify opportunities for a new business to compete effectively.



### 3. Market Pricing Research

- Research what cleaning companies charge across Australia.

- Compare hourly rates, fixed-price contracts, and other pricing models.

- Investigate pricing for office cleaning, commercial buildings, medical centres, schools, warehouses, and other relevant premises.

- Contact cleaning companies or prospective customers where appropriate to verify market rates.

- Explain how prices vary by location, job size, frequency, and service requirements.



### 4. Customer and Contract Research

- Identify businesses and organisations that purchase cleaning services.

- Research how to find commercial cleaning contracts.

- Investigate private-sector opportunities, property management companies, facility managers, and relevant government procurement opportunities.

- Identify tender websites and explain the process of applying for cleaning contracts.

- Research typical contract requirements and customer expectations.



### 5. Business Setup and Operating Costs

- Research the costs involved in starting and operating a cleaning business in Australia.

- Investigate equipment, cleaning supplies, insurance, staff wages, training, and transportation costs.

- Research relevant licences, workplace safety requirements, and other compliance obligations.

- Analyse the difference between operating with employees, subcontractors, and owner-operators.



### 6. Profitability and Business Model Analysis

- Estimate potential revenue and operating costs using clearly stated assumptions.

- Develop example profit-and-loss scenarios for small, medium, and larger cleaning operations.

- Compare recurring cleaning contracts with one-off jobs.

- Identify the business models with the strongest potential based on evidence.

- Highlight risks, challenges, and factors that could affect profitability.



### 7. Final Research Report

Prepare a professional report that includes:

- Australian cleaning industry overview.

- Competitor database and pricing comparison.

- State-by-state market opportunities.

- Target customer segments.

- Startup and ongoing operating costs.

- Example financial projections.

- Contract acquisition strategies.

- Recommended entry strategy and action plan.



## Required Skills

- Previous experience in market research, business analysis, or industry research.

- Strong online research and data verification skills.

- Experience with competitor pricing analysis.

- Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Ability to prepare professional reports and financial comparisons.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Ability to contact businesses and verify information when necessary.



Experience researching Australian businesses or the commercial cleaning industry is an advantage.



## Expected Deliverables



The successful candidate must provide a detailed, evidence-based market research report with sources, links, dates, comparison tables, calculations, and practical recommendations.



We are looking for actionable business intelligence, not a generic report copied from the internet.



## How to Apply



Please provide:

1. Your previous market research experience.

2. Examples of research reports you have completed.

3. Your experience analysing competitors and pricing.

4. The tools and methods you use to verify information.

5. Your proposed approach to researching the Australian cleaning industry.

6. Your estimated timeframe and total project cost.



Please explain how you would approach this project before applying.
