title: Short-Form Video Editor for a Creative Content Studio — $50–$100 per Video, Steady Monthly Work
description:
ABOUT BRANDLYSS



Brandlyss is a content studio based in the United States. We build the digital presence of scholars, artists, and practice-led entrepreneurs. Our clients have serious bodies of work: books, exhibitions, research, performances, and portfolios. The videos we make have to be as considered as the work they present.



We are growing fast and adding editors to our roster. This is ongoing per-video work, not a one-off project.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- Short-form vertical videos for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts, usually 1 to 3 minutes

- Talking-head footage combined with archival images, artworks, book covers, and B-roll

- On-screen captions, name cards, and titles of works

- Motion graphics and layered animation where the story calls for it



WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GOOD AT THIS JOB



- You read the script before you cut. We supply an approved script for every video. Captions are pasted from that script, never auto-transcribed. Names of people and titles of works must appear exactly as written.

- You make creative decisions without being asked: pacing, B-roll, music, and where an image should land.

- You find your own B-roll and supporting images when we do not supply them.

- Your edits feel refined, not loud. No meme effects, no over-editing, and no AI-generated visuals or voices unless we ask for them.

- You give a delivery date and you hit it.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2 or more years editing short-form video for clients, with a portfolio to show it. Open to less experience with a solid portfolio

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or an equivalent for motion graphics

- Strong color correction and clean audio: noise removal, levels, and music mix

- Excellent written English, with close attention to spelling and punctuation

- Reliable internet and a computer that handles 4K footage

- Familiar with 
, where all feedback arrives as timestamped comments

- Day-to-day communication on WhatsApp, with a reply within one working day; comfortable with Slack or other messaging platforms



NICE TO HAVE



- Graphic design for carousels and static posts

- Experience with documentary, museum, academic, arts, fashion or publishing content

- Storyboarding from a script or a concept



WHAT EVERY VIDEO INCLUDES



- Length: 1 to 3 minutes, vertical

- Captions: included in every video, pasted from our script

- Motion graphics: included in every video, such as name cards, titles, and layered animation

- Revisions: included in the rate. Every cut goes through our internal review first, and any fixes needed to make it client-ready are part of the edit. After that, expect up to 2 rounds of client feedback.

- Volume: 4 to 6 videos a month guaranteed once you prove consistent quality and delivery. Until then, work is assigned video by video.



PAY AND HOW IT WORKS



- Paid trial: one test edit of 60 seconds or less for $40 USD, paid on delivery whether or not we use it

- After the trial: $50 USD per video to start

- Once you prove consistent quality and on-time delivery: $55 to $60 per video with 4 to 6 videos guaranteed every month. Senior editors, whose first cuts are client-ready without creative direction from us, earn $100 per video.

- Bonuses at the higher tiers for clean first drafts, on-time streaks, and high-performing videos

- You work your own hours. First drafts are due within 2-3 days of receiving footage, depending on the length of footage, and revisions are due within 24 hours.

- Every brief and every round of feedback comes from one person, our founder.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip any step are not reviewed.



1. Use this exact subject line: Brandlyss Editor: Your Full Name

2. Send 3 links to short-form videos you edited yourself. For each one, write one sentence on what you did and what you did not do.

3. Tell us your editing software, whether you have used 
, and how many videos you can take on each week.

4. Tell us your first-draft turnaround for a 90-second video.

5. Complete the caption check. Below is a script line and the caption an editor typed from it. List every difference between them.



Script: Barkley L. Hendricks painted Lawdy Mama in 1969, and it changed how I look at portraiture.



Caption: Barclay L. Hendricks painted Lawdy Mamma in 1969 and it changed how I look at portaiture.



Shortlisted editors are invited to the paid trial.

title: Driver Care Advocate & Fleet Support Specialist (Remote)
description:
About the Role



Behind every steering wheel in our fleet is a dedicated man or woman carrying the weight of the day: tight schedules, unpredictable highway traffic, demanding routes, and everyday life waiting at home. When frustrations mount or the day turns chaotic, our drivers do not need an armchair therapist, a corporate lecture, or unsolicited advice.



They need a calm, steady anchor on the other end of the line -someone who listens, helps them take a breath, and de-escalates high-stress moments before they spiral out of control.



We are seeking a warm, grounded Driver Care Advocate to serve as a supportive presence for our drivers across the Southeast. Beyond phone de-escalation, this role participates in driver onboarding, team meetings, and virtual check-ins. Your mission is simple: listen without judgment, speak peace into chaotic situations, help drivers decompress, and remind them that they are valued, respected, and never on the road alone.



Core Responsibilities

Active Listening & Emotional De-escalation: Step directly into tense, high-pressure situations to talk drivers "off the ledge" when route frustrations, road delays, or personal stresses threaten to derail their day.



Proactive Check-Ins: Conduct friendly, low-pressure outbound calls to drivers on the road just to ask: "How is your route treating you today?" and offer an open ear.



Holding Safe Space Without Giving Unsolicited Advice: Allow drivers to vent and leave the stress on the call without attempting marital therapy, legal advice, or financial consulting.



Mindset & Breath Resets: Guide drivers through practical, immediate calming techniques - encouraging them to pause, take deep breaths, step out of the cab to stretch, and refocus on finishing their route safely.



Video Engagement & Onboarding Presence: Welcome new drivers during virtual onboarding sessions, attend operational video meetings, and connect with drivers during lot breaks.



Preserving Driver Morale: Serve as an advocate whose warmth, consistency, and genuine care keep good drivers engaged, valued, and retained in our fleet.



Our Culture & Values

We operate on a strong foundation of servant leadership, personal grace, and moral grounding. Our ideal advocate is someone who is comfortable speaking blessings, offering words of faith, hope, and prayer when welcomed by the driver, and reassuring our team that God has their steps in His hands and that everything is going to be okay.



Mandatory Requirements

100% Native-Level, Accent-Free Spoken English: Crystal-clear verbal clarity and a clean, neutral accent are strictly non-negotiable. Drivers communicate through hands-free vehicle audio, Bluetooth, and cellular lines with background road noise; there can be zero accent friction, lag, or difficulty understanding what is being said.



High-Influence ("I") Presence: A naturally soothing, confident, and persuasive vocal tone that instantly lowers the temperature of an agitated driver.



Professional On-Camera Presence: A warm, engaging presentation on video calls with a quiet, organized, and distraction-free remote work environment.



Firm Boundary Discipline: The wisdom to offer surface-level comfort, encouragement, and active listening without overstepping into clinical psychology or operational dispatch management.



Unshakable Composure: The ability to remain patient, unhurried, and peaceful even when the person on the other end is angry, overwhelmed, or in panic mode.



Reliability: Consistent availability and immediate responsiveness during scheduled operational fleet hours (US Eastern Time).



How to Apply (Required Video Introduction)

We do not review traditional text resumes for this position. Because this role lives across phone de-escalation, driver onboarding, and team video meetings, we evaluate personal presence, vocal warmth, and clear communication first.



To be considered, you must submit a link to a 60-to-90-second video recording (using a free tool like 
, a smartphone video uploaded to Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube link) covering two things:



Brief Introduction (15–20 seconds): Introduce yourself and share why supporting frontline drivers through encouragement and active listening resonates with you.



The De-escalation Scenario (45–60 seconds): Simulate how you would address this real-world situation:



"You are reaching out to Marcus, a driver who has been stuck in bumper-to-bumper traffic for two hours, is running late for his afternoon pickups, and is threatening to park the vehicle and walk off the job because he is fed up. Show us how you would open that conversation, help him take a breath, and de-escalate the moment."



****ATTENTION*****  (Applications submitted without a video link will be automatically disqualified.)

Coordinate deadlines and supporting documentation for ongoing business projects.



Research software, systems, and tools that can improve productivity and efficiency.



Assist with organizing customer, vendor, and business contact information.



Support other executive and operational projects as assigned.



7. Financial Administrative Coordination



Although a separate Bookkeeper will manage primary accounting responsibilities, the Executive Assistant will help ensure financial information is collected, organized, and submitted on time.



Responsibilities include:



Collecting and organizing invoices, receipts, and supporting documentation.



Tracking administrative payment deadlines and outstanding financial requests.



Following up on unpaid invoices and outstanding receivables as directed.



Coordinating with the Bookkeeper regarding missing financial records.



Assisting with vendor communications and payment-related inquiries.



Monitoring completion of assigned financial administrative tasks.



Helping maintain organized financial documentation across multiple businesses.



This position does not require independently preparing financial statements, performing bank reconciliations, or managing full-cycle bookkeeping.



Required Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving abilities.



Experience coordinating with multiple individuals, departments, or businesses.



Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office,
, calendars, and spreadsheets.



Comfortable learning new software, business platforms, and administrative systems.



Ability to work independently and proactively without constant supervision.



Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.



Professional judgment, discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.



Reliable internet connection, computer, and remote working environment.



Availability to participate in scheduled meetings during U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare, behavioral health, or social services administrative experience.



Restaurant, hospitality, catering, or event operations experience.

Schedule & Compensation

Schedule: Flexible, but applicants must be available for scheduled meetings, timely communication, and agreed-upon responsibilities during U.S. business hours when necessary.

Additional hours, responsibilities, and compensation adjustments may become available based on demonstrated performance, reliability, business growth, and operational needs.



Performance & Accountability Expectations



We are looking for someone who can genuinely reduce the administrative burden of managing multiple businesses.



The successful candidate must be able to:



Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.



Anticipate needs and identify priorities.



Communicate proactively without waiting to be asked.



Follow through on assignments until they are completed.



Identify problems and present possible solutions.



Maintain accurate records and organized systems.



Meet deadlines consistently.



Provide clear updates on completed, pending, and overdue tasks.



Handle confidential business information professionally.



Adapt quickly as business priorities change.



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We need a proactive professional who can help keep multiple businesses moving forward.



Required Application Questions

How many years of executive assistance, administrative coordination, or business operations experience do you have? Describe the executives or businesses you supported.

Selection & Onboarding Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in individual interviews and, where appropriate, practical skills assessments.

Following acceptance of the offer and completion of the required onboarding documentation, newly hired contractors will participate in a mandatory group orientation.

If you are an experienced, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-business environment, we encourage you to apply.

title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT AGENT FOR SHOPIFY BRAND
description:
Apex Follix is looking for a part-time Customer Support Agent to join our team!

As our Customer Support Agent, you will be responsible for handling every customer interaction that our automations can’t solve, resolving tickets from start to finish, and making sure every customer has a world-class experience. You will turn frustrated customers into brand advocates by providing fast, empathetic, and effective solutions.

We are looking to hire someone with experience in e-commerce customer support. The ideal candidate has prior experience with DTC brands, knows how to handle disputes and difficult cases, and can think for themselves. You see a problem, you solve it, and you tell us how to stop it from happening again.

Who are we?

 At Apex Follix, we are transforming the lives of people dealing with hair thinning and hair loss. We sell a hair growth and scalp-health system built around a micro-infusion serum treatment, along with complementary products. We serve thousands of customers, mainly in Mexico, with a core team of just 2 people. We’ve automated most of our operations with AI workflows, which lets a very small team do the work of a much bigger one. We are looking to continue our growth by finding a great customer support agent to play a pivotal role in scaling!

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less, and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following four core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better every day. We love learning. Every problem is an opportunity to grow, and if you have ideas to simplify how we work, we want to hear them.

If you want a job where you wait for instructions, this isn’t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and grow with a brand on its way to $20M+ a year... If you want to work with a small group of smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or micromanagement, where your ideas actually get implemented, then you’ve come to the right place.

If you wish to apply, mention the word “PELO” in your application message.

Key Objectives

 Resolve every ticket that reaches you during your check-ins (morning, afternoon, and night) while maintaining a friendly, helpful tone.

 Apply problem-solving principles to resolve shipping, product, and order issues autonomously.

 Operate with a high degree of autonomy, without needing hand-holding.

 Communicate with our supplier to make sure orders ship on time and logistics run without delays.

 Identify where our AI automations fall short and give clear direction on how to improve them. Implementing those improvements yourself is highly valued.

 Bring ideas that simplify our processes.

Requirements

 Fully remote.

 Fluent in English (written). All internal communication is in English.

 Proven experience in Customer Support for e-commerce brands, ideally DTC.

 Experience with Shopify.

 Experience handling disputes and chargebacks.

 Available for three short check-ins per day (morning, afternoon, and night), including weekends when needed.

 Spanish is not required but is highly appreciated, since most of our customers speak it. Translation tools are fine if your replies sound natural.

 Experience with AI tools, especially Claude / Claude Code, is a plus.

 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.

KPI’S you will own

 Zero open tickets at the end of each check-in.

Accountabilities

 Resolve customer tickets from start to finish.

 Process refunds, replacements, and order cancellations according to company policy.

 Handle payment disputes and chargebacks, gathering the right evidence and responding on time.

 Follow up with our supplier on shipments and flag any delays before customers notice them.

 Proactively identify and report “fire” situations (e.g., website bugs, mass shipping delays).

This Role Is Not For You If

 You need step-by-step instructions to get things done. This is a high-autonomy role where you’re trusted to make decisions.

 You are a perfectionist who spends 20 minutes drafting a single reply. Efficiency, templates, and quick personalization are key.

 You struggle with fast-paced changes. Our policies, products, and automations can change overnight, and you must be able to adapt without frustration.

 You solve the same problem twice instead of suggesting how to fix it for good.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

 To apply, please submit a video introduction along with your CV.

If you’re a strong match, we’ll invite you to a single interview covering both technical ability (via mock tickets) and culture fit.

 We move quickly and aim to hire the right candidate within 5–7 days. We pride ourselves on timely responses. We won’t leave you hanging.

Salary Expectation

 USD $7 – $9.50 per hour (approx. 1 hour per day, split across 3 check-ins), based on experience and expertise.

title: Operations Manager (Supply Chain & Subscriptions) – E-Commerce Subscription Brand
description:
ABOUT US

We are a fast-growing e-commerce company running a scaling subscription brand in the health & wellness space, selling across the Big 5 English-speaking markets. We are a lean, fully remote international team of ~15 people led by two founders, with dedicated departments for creative, media buying, CRO,
, customer service and supply chain, and clear KPIs and bonus structures across the team.



We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to own our back-end: supply chain, subscriptions and retention, customer service oversight, payment operations and finance coordination. The goal is simple: the back-end runs smoothly without the founders having to chase it.



THE ROLE

You report directly to the two founders and act as the operational backbone of the company. Our product is manufactured in China and shipped worldwide through 3PL partners. You make sure we never run out of stock, orders arrive fast, costs go down, customers stay subscribed, and the numbers are organized and reported on time.



Supply chain and retention are the key priorities of this role. Everything else supports those two.



This is a hands-on management role for someone independent. You compile the data, build the reports and flag the problems yourself, before anyone has to ask. The role is task-based, not clock-based: we care about outcomes and clear communication, not about you being online around the clock.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Supply chain (key priority)

- Forecast stock based on daily order and subscription rebill volume, keeping a safety buffer and planning around production lead times and factory holidays

- Place and track bulk orders with our manufacturer: timelines, packaging, quality follow-ups

- Check the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and quality documents for every production batch

- Manage and negotiate with our 3PLs: shipping lines, delivery times per market, rates and payment terms

- Work on lowering COGS and shipping cost per order without hurting delivery times

- Work closely with our shipping customer service agent, who tracks shipments daily, to validate real delivery times against what our 3PLs promise



Subscriptions & retention (key priority)

- Own the operational side of our subscription program: rebills, churn, cancellation and save rates

- Collect and understand customer feedback (tickets, cancellation reasons, surveys) and turn it into clear actions that improve retention

- Spot how shipping, product and service issues affect cancellations, and fix the root cause



Customer service oversight

- We have a Customer Service Manager in place who runs the team day to day; you oversee the department

- Set clear KPIs, track them, and run the monthly reporting and bonus calculations

- Highlight ongoing issues to the founders early, with a proposed solution



Chargebacks & payment operations

- Monitor chargeback rates and understand what is driving them

- Keep payment processor requirements and compliance follow-ups organized

- Coordinate with customer service so disputes are prevented and handled on time



Finance coordination

- Help coordinate with our finance team: supplier and 3PL invoices, payment schedules, cost tracking

- Make sure our bookkeeper and accounting partner have what they need, complete and on time

- Report weekly to the founders on the key back-end numbers: stock cover, delivery times, COGS, churn, chargebacks, CS performance



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience in a subscription-based e-commerce business is required: you understand recurring billing, rebill cycles, churn and retention

- Proven supply chain experience: inventory forecasting, manufacturer orders and 3PL management for a physical product

- Working knowledge of chargebacks and payment operations: you understand how disputes work and what keeps a merchant account healthy

- 3+ years in an operations, supply chain or team lead role in e-commerce / DTC

- Experience with supplements or other regulated health products is a plus

- Experience with China-based suppliers and international shipping is a plus

- Experience with Loop Subscriptions is a plus

- Strong with numbers and spreadsheets: you enjoy compiling data and building reports

- Confident negotiator, firm but fair with suppliers and partners

- Independent and proactive: you report on your own initiative, without the founders constantly following up

- You take the job seriously and are looking for a long-term role

- Excellent written English; most of our communication is async and in writing

- Comfortable with Shopify, Slack, ClickUp (or similar) and Google Workspace

- Available during Asian timezone working hours



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term remote position with a stable but flexible weekly schedule

- $1,500–$2,000 USD per month, based on experience, plus a performance bonus structure with clear, measurable targets

- Real responsibility and direct access to the founders

- Room to grow with the brand as we scale

- A professional, no-nonsense team culture: clear KPIs, honest feedback, no micromanagement



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with:

1. Your prior work experience: the subscription brand(s) you worked with, your role, and what you owned.

2. One example of a supply chain problem you fixed (stockout, slow delivery, supplier issue, high costs): what was broken, what did you change, and what was the measurable result?

3. One report or dashboard you built on your own initiative, and what decision it led to.

4. Your available hours and expected monthly salary.



A short Loom video or any other introduction of yourself is appreciated.



Start your application with the word "Mango" so we know you read the full post. Applications without the four points above will not be considered.

title: Bookkeeper & Financial Administrative Assistant
description:
We are seeking a dependable, highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Bookkeeper & Financial Administrative Assistant to support the financial operations of multiple businesses operating in the United States and the U.S. Virgin Islands.



Our businesses operate across several industries, including behavioral health and social services, restaurants, hospitality, catering, events, consulting, and creative ventures.



We are looking for someone who understands bookkeeping principles, has practical experience working with financial records, and can independently maintain accurate financial information while helping improve existing accounting processes.



This position requires someone who is comfortable working with numbers, identifying discrepancies, meeting deadlines, and maintaining strict confidentiality.



We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience in payroll processing, bank reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.



Key Responsibilities



1. Bookkeeping & Financial Record Management



Maintain accurate and organized bookkeeping records for multiple businesses.



Record, review, and categorize income, expenses, deposits, and financial transactions.



Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and other financial accounts.



Identify and investigate missing transactions, duplicate entries, and discrepancies.



Organize receipts, invoices, statements, and supporting financial documentation.



Assist with bringing outstanding bookkeeping records current and resolving existing backlogs.



Maintain separate financial records and accounting documentation for each business.



Help establish and maintain consistent bookkeeping procedures and internal financial controls.



2. Payroll Processing & Administration



Prepare and calculate payroll for Workers and contractors across multiple businesses.



Review approved timesheets, hours worked, compensation rates, and payroll adjustments.



Calculate gross compensation, approved reimbursements, mileage, and applicable deductions.



Verify payroll calculations for accuracy and identify discrepancies before submission.



Prepare payroll registers, payment summaries, and supporting documentation.



Assist with processing payroll through designated payroll and accounting platforms.



Maintain accurate payroll records, payment histories, and compensation documentation.



Reconcile payroll payments against bank transactions and accounting records.



Track payroll schedules and deadlines to ensure timely processing.



Coordinate with the Executive Assistant and management to resolve missing documentation, incorrect hours, and payroll discrepancies.



Assist with preparing payroll-related reports and documentation for accountants and other authorized professionals.



All payroll payments must be reviewed and approved by management before funds are released.



3. Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



Maintain accurate records of outstanding customer invoices and vendor bills.



Track accounts payable, due dates, recurring expenses, and financial obligations.



Monitor accounts receivable and identify overdue or outstanding payments.



Prepare accounts receivable aging reports and payment tracking summaries.



Assist with invoicing, payment reminders, and collections follow-up.



Reconcile payments received against outstanding invoices.



Identify missing payments, discrepancies, duplicate invoices, and billing errors.



Coordinate with the Executive Assistant and management regarding outstanding financial matters.



Maintain accurate records of vendor payments, reimbursements, and financial commitments.



4. Financial Reporting, Budgeting & Cash Flow



Prepare and maintain monthly financial summaries and bookkeeping reports.



Assist with preparing profit-and-loss statements and balance sheets.



Track business income, expenses, and operating costs.



Monitor cash flow and identify upcoming financial obligations.



Assist with preparing monthly and annual operating budgets.



Track actual expenses against established budgets.



Help identify unnecessary expenses, financial discrepancies, and opportunities for improved financial efficiency.



Prepare organized financial information for management review.



Assist with maintaining records needed for accountants, tax professionals, and financial reporting.



5. Multi-Business Financial Coordination



Maintain clear financial separation between multiple businesses.



Organize and track financial documents, invoices, receipts, and statements.



Coordinate with management and the Executive Assistant to obtain missing financial information.



Support financial tracking for restaurant operations, hospitality services, catering, events, and healthcare-related businesses.



Assist with tracking service-related invoices, payments, and outstanding reimbursements.



Maintain accurate records of business-related purchases, vendor transactions, and operating expenses.



Recommend improvements to bookkeeping workflows, reporting systems, and financial organization.



6. Administrative Support & Accountability



Maintain organized digital financial files and spreadsheets.



Prepare financial updates and communicate outstanding issues to management.



Monitor assigned deadlines and complete tasks without repeated reminders.



Provide regular updates on completed work, pending items, and identified discrepancies.

Required Qualifications



Previous hands-on bookkeeping, accounting support, financial auditing, or reconciliation experience.



Experience preparing or reviewing payroll calculations and related documentation.



Working knowledge of bank and credit card reconciliations.



Understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Accurate and detail-oriented.



Honest, trustworthy, and dependable.



Comfortable handling confidential financial information.



Organized and capable of supporting multiple businesses.



Proactive in identifying problems and recommending solutions.

Selection & Onboarding Process

Following acceptance of the offer and completion of the required onboarding documentation, newly hired contractors will participate in a mandatory group orientation.

title: ERP Consultant (Sage 300/Acumatica)
description:
The ERP Consultant is responsible for helping clients implement, optimize, support, and improve their Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Sage 300 and/or Acumatica and a solid understanding of accounting, finance, inventory, purchasing, sales, and other business processes.



The ERP Consultant works directly with clients to understand their business requirements, assess existing processes, configure ERP solutions, troubleshoot system issues, support implementations and upgrades, and recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency.



This role requires a combination of ERP functional expertise, business analysis, client consulting, and technical understanding. The consultant will also work closely with developers and technical teams when customizations, integrations, or complex technical solutions are required.

- Advise clients on ERP best practices while minimizing unnecessary customization.

Sage 300 / Acumatica Expertise

- Configure and support relevant ERP modules.

- Troubleshoot functional issues and determine whether problems are related to configuration, data, integrations, customizations, or user processes.

- Assist clients with ERP upgrades, enhancements, and system optimization.

- Evaluate existing configurations and recommend improvements.

- Work with developers on Sage 300 or Acumatica customizations where required.

System Configuration & Optimization

- Recommend improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and data visibility.

ERP Support & Troubleshooting

Required:

- Experience working directly with clients.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, clients, and priorities.



Why join us

You'll work directly with businesses to help modernize their operations through one of the fastest-growing cloud ERP platforms, while contributing to implementation, optimization, and transformation projects.

title: AI UGC Image Creator - Opportunity to Grow into a Creative Designer
description:
We’re looking for someone who can create highly realistic AI-generated lifestyle images for a fashion brand targeting British women aged 40 and above.



You’ll initially create three UGC-style images per product:



- One branded unboxing photo: the product inside an open package featuring our logo and branding.

- One casual selfie: a woman wearing the product, taking a natural selfie or mirror selfie at home.

- One everyday lifestyle photo: a woman wearing the product, photographed by someone else in a relaxed setting.



These are AI-generated visual concepts, rather than verified customer testimonials.



What we’re looking for



Your images should have the realism of everyday phone photography: natural lighting, realistic skin texture, relaxed poses and believable surroundings. Small imperfections in framing should make the images feel spontaneous.



Product accuracy is essential. Colours, fabric, shape, fit and details must match the references provided. Hands, reflections, packaging and logos must also look convincing.



Where relevant, the images should reflect the product offer—for example, showing two colours together for a buy one, get one free deal.



Your responsibilities



We’ll provide product photos, branding, the product page and a brief. You’ll develop three distinct concepts, generate the images and carefully check the results before delivery.



You should be comfortable working independently, spotting visual errors and refining your work. Experience with AI image generation and image editing is essential.



Opportunity to grow



The role starts with these three images per product. If your work consistently meets our quality standards, you can grow into a Creative Designer role, creating static ads, developing concepts and hooks, and producing AI 
 videos for
 and Instagram campaigns.



How to apply



Please share examples of your most realistic AI-generated fashion or lifestyle images, the tools you use and your typical turnaround time for three images.

title: AI Operations Assistant who thinks in systems | Work directly with founder | Grow into running client operations
description:
Do you think in systems, want to help companies scale with AI, and can you stay focused on the bottleneck? Then please watch this video: 



If you have only studied IT, this might not be the right job for you.

If you have studied Business and IT, this could be the perfect job for you.

If you have just studied Business, it might be the right job for you.



I would like to see signs of exceptional performance or thinking.



WHAT THIS IS



I run an Irish company that builds AI-driven operations for growing businesses. Right now I'm fractional Operations Manager for multiple agencies, where I build the systems, automations, and tracking that let them scale. I automate everything that can be automated. This role is my right hand for everything that still needs a sharp human.



You would be working directly with me. And you would not be my first Filipino teammate: over the years I have worked with 20+ people from the Philippines through Upwork and OnlineJobs.ph, so I know how to make this work well for both sides. As the work grows, this role grows with it.



A bit about me: I started programming at 13, had my first client at 14, and left the standard education path to learn on my own. I was working as a developer at 17 and made this flowchart at 19 with no guidance: 
 

Since then I have built systems and automations for 50+ companies, including founders from the Forbes 30 Under 30 list.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



The goal of this role: you end up running the operations of one or more of our client companies. You start as my right hand and take over one system at a time.



1. Map how a business actually works. On live calls with me, you lay out flowcharts of how a client gets customers, delivers, and gets paid

2. Find the bottleneck. Work out which part of the system is holding the company back and what to fix first

3. Build the systems from those flowcharts in tools like Notion and GoHighLevel (no prior experience with these tools needed), using Claude and other AI tools to build fast. I will teach you my workflows, and I expect you to get good at them

4. Turn what we build into procedures other people can follow: you take a recording or a live walkthrough, write the procedure, then run the task from your own procedure to prove it works

5. Keep the systems true. Check that tasks, records, and data across several clients match reality, catch what looks wrong, and fix the cause, not only the record

6. Roll out changes. Make sure the people using a system know what changed and how to use it

7. Take ownership. One process at a time, you become the person responsible for it end to end, including improving it



In the first weeks, most of your time goes to points 4 and 5, because that is how you learn the systems. A small part of the role is also personal logistics for me (for example scheduling with my chef, keeping household supplies stocked).



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



The work has two modes.



BUILD MODE: when we are diving into a system and building it out, we work LIVE on a Zoom call. Both on, screen sharing, I figure out what needs to happen, you take each task the moment it is clear and do it while I keep working on the next thing, and we review and adjust on the spot. Think of it like mob programming: no briefs sitting in a queue for two days, no handover delays, the system gets built fast and you learn extremely quickly because you see the whole thinking process. I have worked this way with people from the Philippines before, sometimes long days on the same call, and it is intense and energizing. If that sounds draining to you, this is not your role. If it sounds fun, keep reading.



RUN MODE: once a system is built and figured out, the work becomes calmer. You get checklists and short screen recordings (Loom) as instructions, you work through them on your own time within our overlap hours, and you send back your results. Over time you graduate to owning these processes fully.



Most weeks are a mix of both. You get real responsibility fast if you show you can carry it.



THE DEAL



1. Part time to start, around 20 hours per week. Paid per hour worked: $5-7/hour, depending on experience

2. Hours vary from week to week. Some weeks are lighter, and busy weeks can reach 40+ hours. I need someone who wants those hours

3. 13th month pay

4. First raise review after 90 days, tied to the processes you own, not time served

5. Working hours: I'm in Europe, so overlap with my day means your AFTERNOON and EVENING (around 15:00-24:00 Philippine time). I need at least 3 hours of overlap. Your mornings stay yours, and the normal working hours are nothing like the graveyard shifts of a US client. The exact schedule inside that window is something we agree on together



Side projects and other gigs are fine. I would honestly rather hire someone who builds things. The deal is simple: the hours we agree on are sacred, and when I need extra hours on short notice (24 to 48 hours), this role comes first. If you can commit to that, everything else is your time.



WHO YOU ARE



1. You think in systems: when one thing changes, you ask what else it affects. You have mapped how work moves between people in a business, not only how IT systems connect

2. You have used Claude Code for actual work and created skills

3. Detail-oriented: you follow instructions exactly and flag anything that looks off instead of guessing

4. You enjoy working live on a call: screen sharing, getting feedback, adjusting in real time

5. Strong written and spoken English (we talk a lot on calls)

6. Reliable internet and your own computer, good enough for long Zoom calls with screen share and remote control. Please test this before you apply

7. Available now, with room to grow your hours

8. Hungry. You want to learn how modern businesses are actually built



HOW THE HIRING WORKS



1. You apply (see below). I review every application that follows the instructions within 48 hours

2. Shortlisted candidates get a career timeline template to fill in: your work history as a timeline, with the highlights, the lowlights, and why you moved on each time, plus two references. Specifics matter more than polish, and I do contact references

3. A short video call with me, where I ask about your timeline

4. Then a PAID live working session: you join me on Zoom, we work on real tasks together, real pay. Both of us see if it fits

5. If it fits, we start properly



HOW TO APPLY



Send these three things (short and honest beats long and polished):



1. Links to flowcharts you have made. At least one must show a BUSINESS process: how work moves between people in a company (for example client onboarding, order handling, hiring). IT system diagrams are welcome in addition. If yours are confidential, map a process from a business you know well.

2. A Loom video of 2 minutes or less where you walk me through the business flowchart, tell me one thing you got wrong in the first version and what you changed, and introduce yourself.

3. A link to something you have built with AI tools that I can open and look at: an application, a dashboard, an automation, or a working tool. If it cannot be shared publicly, send a short screen recording of you using it. A description alone does not count. Add one or two lines on what it does and which parts you built yourself.



And answer this one question:



4. What other work or commitments do you have right now, and what is the maximum weekly hours you could reliably give me?

title: Remote Business Development & Market Research Specialist – Scrap Metal Industry (Australia)
description:
# Job Title: Remote Business Development & Market Research Specialist – Scrap Metal Industry (Australia)



**Job Type:** Part-Time / Full-Time  

**Location:** Remote  

**Target Market:** Australia – All States and Territories



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced and motivated Business Development & Market Research Specialist to help us grow our scrap metal business across Australia.



The successful candidate will be responsible for researching the scrap metal market, identifying suppliers and buyers, investigating competitor prices, generating leads, contacting businesses, and finding new opportunities to increase our business.



We need someone who can conduct detailed research, make professional cold calls, send business
s, analyse market prices, and provide practical recommendations based on real market information.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

- Research the Australian scrap metal industry, including aluminium, copper, brass, steel and other recyclable metals.

- Identify scrap yards, recycling companies, metal dealers, manufacturers and industrial businesses.

- Investigate what competitors are paying for scrap metal and what prices they are selling it for.

- Collect and compare market prices across different Australian states and cities.

- Contact businesses to verify prices when information is not publicly available.

- Monitor market trends and identify profitable buying and selling opportunities.



### 2. Lead Generation & Supplier Research

- Find businesses that generate scrap metal, including factories, manufacturers, demolition contractors, metal fabricators and construction companies.

- Identify potential scrap suppliers and buyers.

- Build accurate databases containing company names, contact details, locations and relevant decision-makers.

- Research businesses that may have regular or large quantities of scrap metal available.

- Identify opportunities to establish long-term supplier and customer relationships.



### 3. Cold Calling &
 Marketing

- Make outbound calls to Australian businesses to introduce our company.

- Contact potential suppliers to find out what materials they generate, their quantities and their current selling arrangements.

- Contact potential buyers to understand their material requirements and purchasing prices.

- Send professional B2B
s and follow up with prospects.

- Build relationships with business owners, purchasing managers and operations managers.

- Arrange meetings and negotiate initial discussions about potential supply and sales agreements.



### 4. Business Development

- Identify new markets, suppliers, buyers and trading opportunities.

- Research opportunities to buy scrap metal at competitive prices and sell it to suitable buyers.

- Identify businesses with ongoing scrap metal supply.

- Help develop strategies to expand our business across Australia.

- Maintain a pipeline of prospective suppliers, customers and commercial opportunities.



### 5. Reporting & Analysis

- Prepare weekly reports showing market prices, competitor findings and new opportunities.

- Maintain organised records using Excel, Google Sheets or a CRM.

- Track calls,
s, responses, qualified leads and follow-ups.

- Provide evidence and sources for reported prices wherever possible.

- Recommend practical actions to help improve our buying prices, selling prices and business margins.



## Required Skills & Experience

- Experience in business development, market research, B2B sales or lead generation.

- Strong online research and data analysis skills.

- Confidence making cold calls to Australian businesses.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Experience with Excel, Google Sheets and CRM systems.

- Ability to research competitors and verify market pricing.

- Strong communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and deliver measurable results.



Experience in scrap metal recycling, metal trading, commodities, manufacturing or industrial procurement will be a significant advantage.



## What We Expect



We are looking for someone who does more than collect contact details. We need a person who can understand the market, investigate prices, find genuine suppliers and buyers, contact businesses and identify opportunities that can generate profit.



All market prices should be supported by sources or actual business quotes wherever possible, with the material grade, quantity, location and quote date recorded.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have in market research, lead generation or business development?

2. Have you worked with scrap metal, recycling, commodities or industrial businesses?

3. Have you made cold calls to Australian businesses?

4. How would you research current aluminium, copper and other scrap metal prices across Australia?

5. How would you identify factories, manufacturers and other businesses that regularly generate scrap metal?

6. What tools do you use for market research, lead generation and CRM management?

7. What are your expected hourly rate and availability?



Please provide examples of previous work or results where possible.



**Our goal is to find a reliable person who can help us understand the Australian scrap metal market, build strong supplier and buyer relationships, and identify profitable business opportunities.**

• Good written communication

We are not looking for

 campaigns, or general GHL experience, it will not be considered.

Nice to have

• Experience working with agencies or service businesses

• Basic design sense for clean layout and user experience

• Experience organising video training content and downloadable resources

• Ability to document the setup clearly for our internal team



Hours and pay

title: Appointment Setter – Base + Uncapped Commission | $600–$1,500+ OTE
description:
Appointment Setter – $200 Base + Uncapped Commission | $600–$1,500+ OTE



OTE means on-target earnings. The $600–$1,500+ range is based on achieving approximately 6–8 qualified meetings and generating 1–2 new clients per month. Actual earnings will depend on performance, client pricing, conversions, and retention.



About Us

We are a small Amazon advertising agency that helps founder-led brands grow profitably on Amazon. We're growing and looking for a reliable appointment setter to help us connect with more Amazon brand owners.



What you'll do

- Call founders and owners of small Amazon brands from a lead list we provide, using our parallel dialer

- Offer them a free competitor breakdown for their brand

- Book 15-minute intro calls on our founder's calendar

- Log every call outcome and follow up with interested brands

- Respect every "not interested" or "don't call me" right away



Pay

- $200/month base pay (paid twice a month)

- $30 for each of your first 8 qualified meetings held during the month (paid weekly)

- $40 for each additional qualified meeting held after the first 8 (paid weekly)

- 50% of the first monthly payment collected from each new client generated through your qualified meeting

- 10% of that client's monthly fee for their first six paid months

- No cap on earnings



Signing commissions are paid after the client's first payment clears and the client completes 30 days without a refund or chargeback. Recurring commissions are paid monthly for the client's first six paid months.



What one signed client can earn you:

- $750/month client: $375 signing commission + $450 over six months = $825

- $1,500/month client: $750 signing commission + $900 over six months = $1,650



What counts as a qualified meeting

- You spoke directly with the founder or Amazon decision-maker

- The company actively sells its own brand on Amazon

- The company fits the target profile provided during training

- The prospect expressed genuine interest in the complimentary competitor breakdown or Amazon advertising support

- The meeting was generated through your outreach and actually takes place

- The prospect was not already active in our pipeline



Workload

- About 10–15 hours of calling per week

- A calling block during US business hours that we agree on together

- A minimum of 10 calling hours per week

- All call outcomes logged before the end of each session

- Follow-ups completed on schedule



What we provide

- A parallel dialer and lead lists

- A short script and an easy offer (the free competitor breakdown)

- Training on our process and common objections

- Direct communication with the founder



What you need

- Clear, confident spoken English

- Cold calling or appointment setting experience (B2B preferred)

- Comfort handling objections politely and staying professional

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Availability for 10–15 hours per week during US business hours



Nice to have

- Experience with ecommerce, Amazon sellers or marketing agencies

- Experience using a parallel or power dialer



How it works

- This is an independent contractor role

- We start with a paid 2-week trial ($100 base for the trial period, plus all meeting and client commissions you earn)

- Setters who meet our quality, reliability, and performance standards may be offered a long-term position

- After 60 days, strong performers will be eligible for a compensation review, a higher base, and additional responsibility as the company grows

- You must follow our calling rules, including Do Not Call requirements



How to apply

1. Send a 1–2 minute voice recording responding to this scenario: You have reached the founder of a small Amazon brand for the first time. Introduce yourself, briefly explain why you are calling, and offer the complimentary competitor breakdown.

2. Answer briefly:

   - How many years of cold calling or appointment setting experience do you have, and in which industries?

   - On average, how many meetings did you book per week in your last role?

   - What hours (in US Eastern Time) are you available?



We review every application and reply to shortlisted candidates within a few days.

title: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA (Experienced Only)
description:
# Hiring: Experienced Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



**Pay:** $2.00/hour + Performance Bonuses  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)  

**Position:** Full-Time, Remote  

**Experience:** Previous Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage sourcing experience REQUIRED



## EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



**DO NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before.**



We are an established Amazon FBA business looking for an experienced and reliable Online Arbitrage sourcing VA to help us scale our inventory, especially during Q4.



We need someone who understands Amazon sourcing beyond simply finding products that appear profitable in SellerAmp.



You must already know how to:



- Source profitable Amazon FBA products through Online Arbitrage

- Use SellerAmp SAS and Keepa confidently

- Analyze sales volume, Buy Box history, competition, and price stability

- Find legitimate retailers and suppliers

- Calculate accurate ROI, profit margins, and dollar profit

- Identify price tanking and listing saturation risks

- Find profitable Amazon seller storefronts through reverse sourcing

- Identify realistic bulk-purchasing opportunities

- Work independently without constant supervision



**We are NOT looking to train someone from scratch.**



## YOUR MAIN JOB



Our goal is to consistently find **8–10 VALID ASINs per day**, focusing on profitable, high-volume sourcing opportunities.



**Daily and weekly expectations:**



- Initial evaluation period: Minimum 5 approved ASINs per day (25 per week)

- Standard target after evaluation: 8 approved ASINs per day (40 per week)

- High-performance target: 10+ approved ASINs per day (50+ per week)



Finding random products does NOT count.



Every submitted product must meet our sourcing requirements and pass review.



If submitted ASINs are rejected, you must replace them before the end of the workweek to meet the required weekly target.



**Only approved ASINs count toward your weekly total, not simply submitted ASINs.**



A lead will be evaluated based on whether it meets our documented sourcing requirements at the time of submission. We may choose not to purchase a qualifying lead for business reasons unrelated to its quality.



## Q4 PRODUCT SOURCING PRIORITIES



We are actively looking to take advantage of major Q4 retailer promotions, seasonal discounts, and high-volume selling opportunities.



**Our main priorities are SALES VOLUME, PROFITABILITY, and FAST INVENTORY TURNOVER.**



We are not interested in slow-moving products that only sell a few units per month.



We want products that allow us to purchase meaningful quantities and realistically sell through inventory quickly.



### Preferred Retailers



We strongly encourage sourcing from established U.S. retailers, including:



- Walmart

- Target

- Best Buy

- Home Depot

- Lowe's

- Walgreens

- CVS

- Kohl's

- Macy's

- Other reputable and verified U.S. retailers



Actively research:



- Holiday promotions and seasonal discounts

- Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals

- Clearance and markdown opportunities

- Retailer coupons and promotional codes

- Multi-buy promotions and bundle discounts

- Limited-time sales and price drops

- Products with strong seasonal or year-round demand



All discounts must be legitimate, currently available, and usable at the intended purchase quantity.



Do NOT assume coupons, cashback, or promotional discounts will apply unless verified.



## PRODUCT PROFITABILITY REQUIREMENTS



Every product submitted should meet the following:



- **Minimum ROI:** 35% or higher

- **Preferred Profit Margin:** 20% or higher

- **Minimum Acceptable Profit Margin:** 15%, but ONLY if the product has exceptional sales volume, favorable competition, and strong overall profit potential

- **Minimum Profit Per Unit:** $2.50–$3.00, with higher-profit products strongly preferred



All profit calculations must account for:



- Product purchase cost

- Amazon referral and FBA fees

- Estimated inbound shipping and preparation costs

- Applicable sales tax and other relevant expenses

- Verified discounts or coupons



**ROI is important, but actual dollar profit, realistic competition, and sales velocity matter just as much.**



A product with great ROI does not automatically qualify if it has poor sales potential or unrealistic competition.



## MONTHLY SALES REQUIREMENTS



We are primarily targeting high-demand Amazon listings.



- **Preferred Monthly Sales:** 1,000+ units

- **Minimum Monthly Sales:** 500+ units, ONLY when competition is low and there is a realistic opportunity to capture sales

- **Priority:** Products with consistent sales velocity, stable demand, and realistic Buy Box opportunities



High sales volume alone does NOT qualify a product.



You must analyze the number of competing sellers, Buy Box distribution, pricing trends, and how much inventory we could realistically sell.



For example, a listing selling 1,000 units per month with 30 sellers may be less attractive than one selling 600 units per month with only 4–5 competitive sellers.



Use Keepa and SellerAmp together to evaluate whether demand and profitability are sustainable.



## COMPETITION AND BUY BOX ANALYSIS



Before submitting any product, review:



- Number of active FBA and relevant FBM sellers

- Whether Amazon Retail is competing on the listing

- Buy Box price and historical pricing trends

- Recent seller count increases

- Price tanking and listing saturation risks

- Estimated monthly sales relative to seller count

- Whether we can realistically compete at the projected selling price



Avoid listings with unstable pricing, excessive competition, or obvious signs that profitability will disappear when more sellers enter.



**We want inventory that sells, not inventory that sits in Amazon warehouses.**



## QUANTITY AND INVENTORY REQUIREMENTS



Because we are focused on Q4 volume, we prefer sourcing opportunities that allow us to purchase meaningful quantities.



Ideally, find products where we can realistically purchase:



- 20+ units

- 50+ units

- 100+ units when sales volume and competition support it



Retailers with sufficient available inventory are strongly preferred.



However, do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing unrealistic quantities.



**Example:**



If a product only meets our requirements when buying 25 units, but the listing sells approximately 50 units per month and already has 20 competing sellers, that is NOT a realistic sourcing opportunity.



Consider monthly sales, seller count, competition, purchase quantity, and potential inventory turnover.



Our preferred inventory sell-through target is approximately 30–60 days, depending on the product.



**The deal must make sense for our business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.**



## SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every retailer or supplier before submitting a product.



We previously had a VA submit a fake website impersonating a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website, and the card information was compromised.



**This cannot happen again.**



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



- Fake retailer websites

- Scam or suspicious websites

- Websites impersonating established retailers

- Unverified suppliers

- Websites with questionable payment methods

- Sources offering unrealistic prices

- Retailers with obvious authenticity or product-condition concerns



For unfamiliar websites, verify the domain, business information, independent reviews, and overall legitimacy.



**If you cannot confidently verify a source, DO NOT submit it.**



Any questionable supplier must be flagged for review before the lead can be approved.



## ADDITIONAL PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product must:



- Be a brand we are already approved/ungated to sell

- NOT be a generic or unbranded product

- Match the EXACT Amazon listing, including variation, size, quantity, and packaging

- Be in stock at the submitted purchase price

- Have a correct Amazon ASIN and retailer source link

- Have accurate profitability calculations

- Have realistic competition and sales potential

- Not have been previously submitted by another VA

- Have no obvious authenticity, expiration, or product-condition concerns

- Have no known restrictions preventing us from selling the product



Do not submit duplicate, expired, inaccurate, or misleading deals.



## LEAD SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS



Each submitted lead must include:



1. Amazon ASIN and listing link

2. Retailer/supplier product link

3. Purchase cost and applicable discounts

4. Estimated profit per unit

5. ROI percentage

6. Net profit margin percentage

7. Estimated monthly sales

8. Current competing seller count

9. Buy Box price and relevant price history

10. Recommended purchase quantity

11. Relevant sourcing risks or important observations



All leads should be organized, accurate, and easy to review.



## PERFORMANCE BONUSES 💰



We reward VAs who consistently find profitable products and help grow our Amazon business.



**$1 BONUS PER APPROVED ASIN**



You will receive an additional $1 bonus for every unique, approved ASIN that meets all our sourcing requirements.



This bonus is paid on top of your regular hourly pay.



Additional performance bonuses may be awarded for:



**1. Exceeding Weekly ASIN Targets**



Consistently finding more than 40 approved ASINs per week while maintaining quality.



**2. Finding High-Profit Products**



Discovering products with exceptional ROI, strong margins, and higher dollar profit per unit.



**3. Finding High-Volume Opportunities**



Identifying products that allow us to purchase and realistically sell larger quantities of inventory.



**4. Finding Profitable Amazon Seller Storefronts**



Discovering strong Online Arbitrage seller storefronts that provide valuable opportunities for further product research.



Approved storefronts may qualify for additional bonuses.



**5. Consistent High-Quality Sourcing**



Providing reliable leads that regularly pass review and result in profitable inventory purchases.



**6. Long-Term Performance**



VAs who consistently demonstrate strong sourcing ability, reliability, and accuracy will have opportunities for increased pay and additional bonuses.



**IMPORTANT:** Submitting random ASINs just to increase your bonus will NOT count. Every lead must meet all sourcing requirements and pass review.



Quality always comes first. Five excellent, scalable products can be more valuable than ten low-quality leads.



## WORK EXPECTATIONS



We expect you to:



- Work consistently during scheduled hours

- Communicate clearly and respond to questions promptly

- Work independently without constant supervision

- Double-check all sourcing calculations

- Verify unfamiliar retailers before submitting leads

- Avoid submitting duplicate or previously rejected products

- Stay updated on major retailer promotions and Q4 opportunities

- Be honest about potential sourcing risks

- Prioritize products we can realistically purchase and sell

- Maintain organized and accurate sourcing records



We are looking for someone who takes sourcing seriously and understands how to find profitable inventory at scale.



## HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please answer the following:



1. How long have you been sourcing Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage products?

2. Which sourcing tools have you used? Are you experienced with SellerAmp SAS and Keepa?

3. How many high-quality, profitable ASINs can you realistically find in an 8-hour workday?

4. Do you have experience sourcing from Walmart, Target, and other major U.S. retailers?

5. Are you experienced in reverse sourcing and researching Amazon seller storefronts?

6. How do you verify whether an unfamiliar retailer website is legitimate?

7. Are you comfortable working Monday–Friday, 40 hours per week, at $2.00/hour plus performance bonuses?



**Start your application with the word "SOURCING" so we know you read the entire job description.**



We are looking for an experienced, reliable, and motivated VA who wants a long-term opportunity to grow with our Amazon business.



**If you have real Amazon FBA sourcing experience and can consistently find profitable, high-volume products, we encourage you to apply.**

We’re Vier je stad, a Dutch brand selling handmade glass Christmas ornaments inspired by famous buildings. We spend quite a lot on Meta every month and creative is the most important lever that matters to us. We want one editor to own our statics output.



This is static ad creation for e-commerce. If your portfolio is mainly logos, corporate brochures, or illustrations, with no relevant product or advertising work, this role probably isn’t the right fit.



What you'd be doing

- Producing hook variants — same body, 4–6 different openings, tested against each other

How we work

Our creative workflow combines visual concepts with different products and buying motivations: city pride, memories of home, meaningful gifts, and collecting. You’ll develop a concept, adapt it across different building ornaments, and create variations for testing. Successful concepts are then rolled out across other cities.

• You keep files organised, provide clear progress updates, and take responsibility for delivering finished, usable content.



Tools & skills

- Strong Adobe Photoshop skills.

- A good eye for realism, composition, lighting, and small product details.

What we offer

- $

How to apply

 with the subject line in exactly this format:
