title: ₱10,000 Referral Bonus – Help Us Find a Secluded Rural Rental Home in Luzon
description:
Hello!!



My wife and I are looking for a long-term rental home somewhere in rural Luzon, generally within about 3–4 hours by road from Metro Manila.



We are not looking for a subdivision house, city property, or normal residential neighborhood.



We are looking for something genuinely secluded — a simple but comfortable home surrounded by farmland, trees, mountains, open land, or similar rural surroundings.



Privacy matters more to us than luxury.



We have already searched the normal online channels, including
 Marketplace, Airbnb, and real-estate contacts. The kind of property we want rarely seems to appear publicly.



So this posting is different....What I’m really looking for is word of mouth.



I’m looking for people who are willing to ask around within their own personal networks — family, friends, hometown contacts, neighbors, former coworkers, provincial contacts, friends of friends, etc.



The property does not need to already be advertised for rent. It could be an unused but livable family home, farmhouse, rest house, retirement property, caretaker house, or another private property where the owner might consider a long-term tenant if approached.



If a property you introduce ultimately results in my wife and me signing a lease, I will pay you a ₱10,000 one-time referral bonus.



There is no hourly work, no required number of leads, and no need to spend time scraping property websites.



This is really about personal connections and uncovering properties that may never appear online.



If this sounds interesting, just let me know where you’re based and what areas or provinces you have personal or family connections to. If it looks like there may be a fit, I’ll send over a short set of guidelines and budget information explaining exactly what we’re looking for and what information needs to come with any lead.



We are ready to move once the right property is found, and we’d be excited to take a road trip to personally visit any location that looks especially promising!



Thank you in Advance!

title: Virtual Inside Sale Associate
description:
# GARDENS CARE SENIOR LIVING



## Virtual Inside Sales Associate – Senior Living



**Remote Position | Philippines**



**Position Title:** Virtual Inside Sales Associate\

**Location:** Philippines – Remote\

**Employment Type:** Full-Time\

**Work Schedule:** U.S. Business Hours (Mountain and Pacific Time Zones)\

**Department:** Sales & Marketing\

**Compensation:** Performance-Based Bonus Structure



## About Gardens Care Senior Living



Gardens Care Senior Living operates assisted living and memory care communities throughout the United States. We are dedicated to providing compassionate, personalized care while helping seniors and their families find the right living environment.



We are seeking a highly motivated, persuasive, and exceptionally organized **Virtual Inside Sales Associate based in the Philippines** to manage incoming sales inquiries, make outbound sales calls, schedule community tours, and guide prospective residents and their families through the sales process until successful move-in.



**This is a results-driven sales position, not a traditional virtual assistant or customer service role.**



The ideal candidate is a confident, enthusiastic salesperson with exceptional English communication skills, outstanding organizational abilities, and a proven track record of converting telephone inquiries into appointments and sales.



## Primary Sales Objective



The Virtual Inside Sales Associate is responsible for converting prospective resident inquiries into scheduled community tours and supporting families throughout the admissions process to increase occupancy across Gardens Care communities.



**Minimum Required Sales Performance: 75% of qualified inbound sales calls must convert into scheduled community tours.**



Our preferred performance goal is 85% or higher.



The associate will be measured on completed tours, successful resident move-ins, follow-up effectiveness, and overall sales conversion performance.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Inbound Sales Calls & Tour Conversion



- Professionally answer incoming telephone inquiries from prospective residents, family members, and referral sources.

- Establish immediate rapport and build trust with callers.

- Ask effective discovery questions to understand care needs, financial considerations, urgency, preferred location, and decision-making factors.

- Clearly communicate the benefits and unique advantages of Gardens Care assisted living and memory care communities.

- Use proven consultative sales techniques to motivate families to schedule tours.

- Confidently overcome objections related to pricing, timing, location, and competing communities.

- Create appropriate urgency while remaining compassionate and professional.

- Actively ask for the appointment and secure a confirmed tour date and time.

- Maintain a minimum 75% qualified inbound call-to-tour conversion rate.



### 2. Outbound Sales Calls & Lead Follow-Up



- Proactively contact new inquiries, referral agency leads, and prospective families.

- Respond to new sales inquiries within five minutes during assigned working hours.

- Make consistent outbound calls to prospects who have not yet scheduled tours.

- Follow up through telephone calls,
s, and text messages.

- Reengage older leads and families who previously expressed interest.

- Use effective sales techniques to overcome objections and advance prospects through the sales process.

- Prioritize high-intent leads and families with immediate placement needs.

- Maintain a structured follow-up system to ensure no qualified lead is overlooked.



### 3. Tour Scheduling & Coordination



- Schedule tours at the appropriate Gardens Care community based on each family's needs and preferences.

- Coordinate tour appointments with community Executive Directors and sales representatives.

- Send appointment confirmations, reminders, community addresses, and directions.

- Communicate relevant prospect information to community staff before each tour.

- Follow up with families who cancel or miss appointments to reschedule.

- Track scheduled tours, completed tours, and attendance rates.

- Work toward achieving a minimum 85% scheduled-tour attendance rate.



### 4. Post-Tour Sales & Move-In Conversion



- Contact prospective families within 24 hours after completing a community tour.

- Gather feedback and identify concerns or objections preventing families from moving forward.

- Maintain consistent communication with families throughout the decision-making process.

- Build trust and demonstrate the value of Gardens Care's personalized approach to senior living.

- Encourage timely decisions through professional and ethical sales techniques.

- Coordinate with community leadership to address pricing, availability, and care-related questions.

- Explain the admissions process, required documentation, deposits, and move-in timelines.

- Assist families with completing admission paperwork and outstanding requirements.

- Follow up on pending commitments and help expedite resident move-ins.

- Coordinate with community staff to ensure a smooth transition from initial inquiry through move-in.



### 5. CRM Management & Organization



- Manage assigned leads and sales opportunities using **GoHighLevel (GHL)**.

- Accurately document meaningful telephone calls,
s, text messages, appointments, and follow-up activities.

- Maintain accurate sales pipeline stages and opportunity statuses.

- Create and manage daily follow-up tasks and reminders.

- Track lead sources, scheduled tours, completed tours, resident commitments, and successful move-ins.

- Identify stalled opportunities and proactively reengage prospective families.

- Ensure every active prospect has a documented next step and follow-up date.

- Prepare daily sales activity reports and weekly performance summaries.



### 6. Communication & Team Collaboration



- Communicate regularly with community Executive Directors and Gardens Care sales leadership.

- Notify appropriate staff when tours are scheduled or families are ready to commit.

- Coordinate admissions requirements with community personnel.

- Escalate clinical questions, pricing exceptions, and care-related concerns to authorized management.

- Maintain confidentiality of prospective resident and family information.

- Represent Gardens Care professionally, compassionately, and enthusiastically.



## Required Qualifications



- Must reside in the Philippines and be available to work U.S. business hours.

- **Exceptional spoken and written English with near-native fluency is mandatory.**

- Clear, confident, polished, and professional telephone communication skills.

- Minimum two years of successful experience in inside sales, telephone sales, or appointment setting.

- Proven ability to convert telephone inquiries into scheduled appointments.

- Strong consultative selling, objection-handling, relationship-building, and closing skills.

- Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple leads, appointments, and follow-up schedules simultaneously.

- Experience with CRM software; GoHighLevel preferred.

- Strong computer proficiency, including
, spreadsheets, calendars, and online communication platforms.

- Self-motivated, dependable, accountable, and capable of working independently.

- Reliable high-speed internet, professional headset, and quiet home office.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Previous sales experience in assisted living, memory care, senior living, healthcare, or related industries.

- Experience communicating with U.S.-based customers.

- Familiarity with American culture and customer service expectations.

- Experience using GoHighLevel sales pipelines, workflows, and reporting.

- Demonstrated success meeting aggressive sales conversion targets.

- Experience helping customers navigate complex purchasing or enrollment decisions.



## Performance Standards & Key Performance Indicators



Performance will be evaluated based on measurable sales results, consistent follow-up, and accurate CRM management.



| Performance Metric                        | Required Standard            |

| ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |

| Qualified inbound call-to-tour conversion | **Minimum 75%**              |

| Preferred call-to-tour conversion         | **85% or higher**            |

| New lead response time                    | Within 5 minutes             |

| Tour confirmations                        | 100%                         |

| Scheduled-tour attendance rate            | Target 85% or higher         |

| Post-tour family follow-up                | Within 24 hours              |

| Active lead follow-up compliance          | 100%                         |

| CRM documentation                         | 100%                         |

| Daily sales activity report               | Required                     |

| Move-in support                           | Through successful admission |



**Call-to-Tour Conversion Definition:** Conversion is calculated using qualified, unique inbound sales inquiries and confirmed tour appointments. Duplicate calls, vendor inquiries, existing-resident service calls, and unrelated inquiries are excluded.



## Performance-Based Compensation & Bonus Structure



Gardens Care offers performance-based sales incentives designed to reward successful tour attendance, resident move-ins, and achievement of monthly sales conversion goals.



### Monthly Bonus Schedule



| Performance Achievement                          | Bonus Amount (USD) |

| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ |

| Each qualified, completed community tour         | **$10.00**         |

| Each successful resident move-in                 | **$25.00**         |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 75%–84.99%    | **$100.00**        |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 85% or higher | **$200.00**        |



### Bonus Eligibility Requirements



**1. Completed Community Tour Bonus – $10.00**



- The prospective resident or family must physically attend a scheduled community tour.

- The associate must have been responsible for securing or scheduling the tour.

- The completed tour must be documented in GoHighLevel.

- Cancelled appointments, no-shows, and duplicate tours do not qualify.



**2. Successful Resident Move-In Bonus – $25.00**



- The prospective resident must successfully move into a Gardens Care community.

- The associate must have actively participated in the sales process through lead management, tour scheduling, or post-tour follow-up.

- The move-in must be confirmed by community management and documented in GoHighLevel.



**3. Monthly Call-to-Tour Conversion Bonus**



- Achieving a monthly qualified call-to-tour conversion rate of **75%–84.99% earns $100.00**.

- Achieving a monthly qualified call-to-tour conversion rate of **85% or higher earns $200.00**.

- Monthly conversion bonuses are not cumulative. Only the highest qualifying monthly conversion bonus is awarded.

- Conversion rates will be calculated using qualified, unique inbound sales inquiries and confirmed scheduled tours.

- Duplicate calls, unrelated inquiries, vendors, and existing-resident service calls are excluded.

- A minimum qualified monthly lead volume may be established by management.



### Example Monthly Performance Bonuses



The following example illustrates potential monthly bonus earnings based on successful sales performance.



| Monthly Sales Achievement              | Bonus Amount  |

| -------------------------------------- | ------------- |

| 40 completed community tours × $10     | $400.00       |

| 25 successful resident move-ins × $25  | $625.00       |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 80% | $100.00       |

| **Total Monthly Performance Bonuses**  | **$1,125.00** |



**Higher Performance Example**



If the associate achieves the same 40 completed tours and 25 successful move-ins while maintaining an 85% or higher call-to-tour conversion rate:



| Monthly Sales Achievement                        | Bonus Amount  |

| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------- |

| 40 completed community tours × $10               | $400.00       |

| 25 successful resident move-ins × $25            | $625.00       |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 85% or higher | $200.00       |

| **Total Monthly Performance Bonuses**            | **$1,225.00** |



Actual bonuses depend on verified sales performance and are not guaranteed.



Bonuses will be calculated monthly based on documented results in GoHighLevel and paid in accordance with Gardens Care payroll policies and applicable Philippine employment requirements.



## Characteristics of Our Ideal Candidate



We are seeking an individual who is:



- **Sales-driven:** Confidently asks families to schedule tours and move forward.

- **Persuasive:** Communicates value effectively and knows how to overcome objections.

- **Compassionate:** Understands the emotional challenges families face when selecting senior living.

- **Exceptionally organized:** Never misses important follow-ups or sales opportunities.

- **Persistent:** Maintains consistent communication without becoming overly aggressive.

- **Results-focused:** Takes ownership of tour conversion rates, completed tours, and move-ins.

- **Proactive:** Identifies opportunities and takes initiative without constant supervision.

- **Accountable:** Understands that success is measured by meaningful sales results.



## Our Sales Philosophy



At Gardens Care Senior Living, every inquiry represents a family searching for guidance, reassurance, and quality care for someone they love.



Our Virtual Inside Sales Associate must do more than answer questions or schedule appointments. This individual must become a trusted resource who builds relationships, inspires confidence, motivates families to visit our communities, and actively guides them toward successful move-ins.



**Our goal is to turn inquiries into tours, tours into relationships, and relationships into successful resident move-ins.**



*Plant Effort. Grow Excellence.*

  



Screener to apply: 



 Your Assignment:

Imagine you are a Gardens Care Senior Living Sales Associate, and I am a daughter searching for assisted living for my 85-year-old mother.

My mother is currently living alone, and I am becoming concerned about her safety, medication management, and increasing need for assistance. I have been researching several assisted living communities but have not yet d
 which one to visit.

You called me to discuss Gardens Care Senior Living, but I did not answer.

Your task is to call me at 
and leave me a voi
 convincing me to schedule a tour of Gardens Care Senior Living.

Instructions

Leave a professional voi
 lasting approximately 45–60 seconds.

Introduce yourself as a Gardens Care Senior Living Sales Associate.

Demonstrate excellent English pronunciation, grammar, and conversational fluency.

Show empathy and understanding of my concerns about my mother.

Explain why visiting Gardens Care would be valuable to my family.

Use effective sales techniques to motivate me to schedule a tour.

End with a confident, compelling call to action that encourages me to return your call and schedule an appointment.

Important: Do not simply ask me to call you back. Your objective is to make me genuinely interested in touring Gardens Care Senior Living.

You may prepare your message in advance, but it should sound natural, confident, warm, and conversational—not like you are reading a script.

How We Will Evaluate Your Voi

We will evaluate your performance based on:

English fluency and clarity: Clear pronunciation, professional grammar, and natural communication.

Sales ability: Your ability to create interest, communicate value, and motivate action.

Confidence and enthusiasm: A professional, engaging telephone presence.

Empathy: Your ability to connect with a family facing an important senior care decision.

Closing technique: A strong, persuasive invitation to schedule a community tour.

Professionalism: Organization, appropriate pacing, and overall message quality.

Application Requirement

Applicants who do not complete the telephone screening exercise will not be considered for the position.

We are seeking a sales professional who can turn telephone conversations into scheduled tours—not someone who simply answers calls.

Show us why you are the right person to represent Gardens Care Senior Living!

Plant Effort. Grow Excellence.

title: Senior Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
# WE'RE HIRING: Senior Real Estate Operations Manager (Remote – Philippines)



**Position:** Senior Real Estate Operations Manager / Remote COO



**Employment:** Full-Time, 



**Salary:** $1,500–$2,500 USD per Month (Based on Experience)



**Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM U.S. Eastern Time



**Location:** Remote – Philippines Preferred



### About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment and property management company with a portfolio of over 100 rental units across multiple properties.



We are looking for a highly organized, experienced, and proactive **Senior Operations Manager** to oversee our daily business operations, manage our virtual assistant team, coordinate with contractors and tenants, and develop systems that keep the company running efficiently.



This is NOT a typical virtual assistant position.



We are seeking someone who can think like a business owner, lead a team, solve problems independently, and take full accountability for getting things done.



You will work directly with the business owner and have the authority to manage daily operations.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Team Management & Leadership**



- Directly manage and supervise our existing virtual assistant team.

- Assign tasks, establish priorities, and enforce deadlines.

- Conduct daily check-ins and weekly performance reviews.

- Monitor employee productivity and hold team members accountable.

- Coach, train, and discipline underperforming employees.

- Recommend hiring, termination, and staffing changes to ownership.



**2. SOP Development & Process Improvement**



- Develop, document, and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Ensure every department follows established processes.

- Identify operational inefficiencies and implement improvements.

- Create workflows, checklists, and accountability systems.

- Train employees on new procedures.

- Continuously improve our systems as the business grows.



**3. Property Management Operations**



- Oversee day-to-day operations of our U.S. rental portfolio.

- Coordinate tenant communications and maintenance requests.

- Follow up on late rent, lease renewals, vacancies, and turnovers.

- Ensure maintenance requests are completed promptly.

- Escalate serious tenant disputes and legal matters to ownership.



**4. Construction & Contractor Coordination**



- Communicate directly with U.S.-based contractors and vendors.

- Coordinate repairs, renovations, and property turnovers.

- Track project timelines, budgets, and deadlines.

- Obtain estimates, compare bids, and follow up on incomplete work.

- Review project progress using photos, videos, and reports.

- Approve routine expenses within company guidelines.

- Escalate major budget overruns and project delays.



**5. Financial & Administrative Oversight**



- Supervise VAs responsible for rent collection tracking, mortgage schedules, and accounts payable.

- Review financial dashboards and weekly reports.

- Ensure mortgage payments, vendor invoices, and other obligations are tracked accurately.

- Identify upcoming payment deadlines and cash flow concerns.

- Report discrepancies and financial risks directly to ownership.

- Coordinate administrative tasks without independently authorizing major financial transactions.



**6. Reporting & Accountability**



- Provide a concise daily operations report.

- Conduct weekly management meetings.

- Monitor KPIs across property management, construction, and administrative departments.

- Identify problems early and propose solutions.

- Ensure tasks are completed without constant reminders from ownership.



### Required Qualifications



- Minimum **3–5 years of experience** in U.S. real estate operations, property management, or construction coordination.

- At least 4 years of experience managing remote teams or virtual assistants.

- Demonstrated experience writing and implementing SOPs.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. rental property management processes.

- Experience coordinating with American tenants, contractors, and vendors.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Experience with project management software such as ClickUp, Asana, 
, or Trello.

- Proficiency with spreadsheets, reporting dashboards, and tracking operational KPIs.

- Ability to work independently during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing large rental portfolios (50+ units).

- Background in residential construction, renovation, or maintenance coordination.

- Experience with RentRedi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar software.

- Experience overseeing multiple departments or remote employees.

- Ability to create automation systems and improve operational efficiency.



### What We're Looking For



We value ownership, accountability, communication, and results.



Our ideal candidate:



- Does not need to be reminded repeatedly to complete tasks.

- Follows up proactively until issues are resolved.

- Can confidently manage employees and difficult conversations.

- Thinks ahead and identifies potential problems before they happen.

- Is comfortable making routine decisions independently.

- Understands when to escalate important matters to ownership.

- Builds systems instead of relying on memory or constant supervision.



**We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We want a leader who makes sure the entire team delivers results.**



### Compensation & Growth



- Starting salary: $1,500–$2,500 USD monthly, depending on qualifications.

- Full-time, long-term opportunity.

- Performance-based salary reviews.

- Opportunity to grow into a Director of Operations or COO-level position.

- Direct collaboration with company ownership.



### How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume, including relevant U.S. real estate or construction management experience.

2. A 1–2 minute video introduction explaining your leadership experience and why you're qualified.

3. A brief description of the largest remote team you have managed.

4. An example of an SOP or operational workflow you personally created (with confidential information removed).

5. Your experience communicating directly with U.S. tenants, contractors, or property owners.

6. Your expected monthly salary and earliest available start date.



**Important:** Begin your application with the words **"OPERATIONS LEADER"** so we know you've read the entire job description.



Only applicants with relevant operational management and U.S. real estate or construction experience will be considered.

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads (TikTok B-roll + AI Voiceover)
description:
About us

We are a fast-growing DTC footwear brand in the problem-solving space. Our footwear solves real, everyday problems, so our ads are not fashion or lifestyle looks: they are problem-and-solution ads. We run paid ads on
 and Instagram and we are looking for a full-time video editor to join us long term on a monthly salary.



Please read this first

Our ads are TikTok B-roll clips cut to an AI voiceover, with only a little AI-generated footage blended in where it is needed (it depends on the brief). We do not make fully AI-generated videos.



How our ads are made



We send you a script with three hooks and an example video: an ad we have swiped and reverse engineered.

You add the AI voiceover from the script.

You find and download real B-roll clips from TikTok that match each line of the script. Every clip must be sourced by you from TikTok. No stock footage (Pexels, Storyblocks, Envato or similar) is allowed.

For product shots, you use our product B-roll bank. If a product shot you need is not in the bank, you generate it yourself in Google Flow.

You follow the example video’s format and editing style exactly, and edit it all into a fast, scroll-stopping ad of 30 to 90 seconds, with captions and on-screen text, and export three versions (one per hook).



Formats you will edit



Voiceover montage ads (B-roll cut to a voiceover)

Listicle ads (“5 reasons...” style)

POV and story-style ads

Product demos and side-by-side comparisons



What we are looking for



Proven experience making this type of ad: B-roll cut to a voiceover, for
, Instagram or TikTok

Experience editing problem-and-solution ads for footwear brands

You must be able to reverse engineer ads: break down an example video’s structure, pacing and editing style

You must be able to create an ad from an example video we have swiped and reverse engineered, following the exact same format and editing style

A strong understanding of hook rate, thumb-stop and what makes an ad convert

Strong at finding the right TikTok clips quickly, so every line of the script has a matching visual

Good instincts for hooks, pacing and keeping people watching

Clean captions and on-screen text

Proficient in CapCut

Able to use Google Flow to generate product clips when needed

Reliable, organised, and good at following a brief and our file naming

Comfortable making several ads a week and fast revisions



How to apply



Start your application with the words “TikTok B-roll” so we know you read this post.

Send 2 to 3 ads you edited that use TikTok or UGC B-roll with a voiceover (links please). Fully AI-generated videos will not be considered.

Tell us how you find and download TikTok clips for an ad.

Tell us your experience with Google Flow.

Your expected monthly salary and how many 60-second ads you can deliver per week.
